a: Malchut paras bifne habbayit sheloshim vearba shana, malchut yavan bifne habbayit mea ushemonim shana, malchut chashmonay bifne habbayit mea veshalosh, malchut bet hordos mea veshalosh, mikkan veelach tze vachashov kamma shanim achar chureban habbayit.

Alma matan veshet havo, veat amrat mea ushemonim havo! ella esrin veshet shenin kamu behemanutayyhu bahade yisrael, vela ishtabadu behu, veammetu lehachi la ka chashev lehu kesheppashta malchut harshaa al yisrael.

Amar rav pappa: i tae hay tanna, vela yada perate kamma hava — lishayyeyleh lesafra kamma katev, venitappe alayyhu esrin shenin, umashkach leh lechumereh, vesimanaych: "ze li esrim shana anochi bevetecha".
I tae safra — neshayyeyleh letanna kamma chashev, unevatztzar minnayyhu esrin shenin, umashkach leh lechumereh. vesimanaych: safra betzira, tanna tosfaa.
Tana deve eliyyahu: sheshet alafim shana have haolam, shene alafim tohu, shene alafim tora, shene alafim yemot hammashiach, baavonotenu sherabbu yatzu mehen ma sheyyatzu mehen.
Shene alafim tora meemat? i nema mimmattan tora ad hasheta, lekka kulle hay, dechi meayyeynat behu tere alfe perate dehay alpa hu dahavay.
Ella, mivveet hannefesh asher asu vecharan", ugemiri deavraham behahi shata bar chamshin vetarte hava.
Kamma batzran middetane tanna? arba mea vearbaim utemanya shenin havyayn, ki meayyeynat beh mehannefesh asher asu vecharan" ad mattan tora — arba mea vearbaim utemanya shenin havyayn.
Amar rav pappa: i tae tanna vela yada perateh kamma have — lishayyeyleh lesafra kamma ketiv, venitappe alayyhu arbein vetamne, umashkach leh lechumereh, vesimanaych:
b: "Arbaim ushemone ir". vei tae safra — neshayyeyleh letanna kamma katane, venivatztzar minnayyhu arbaim ushemone, umashkach leh lechumereh, vesimanaych: safra betzira, tanna tosfaa.
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: hay man dela yada kamma shene beshavua hu omed — nittappe chad shatta, venichshov kelale beyovle, uferate beshavue.
Venishkol mimmea tere, venishde apperate, venachshovinhu lifrate beshavue, veyidda kamma shene beshavua, vesimanaych: "ki ze shenatayim haraav bekerev haaretz".

Amar rabbi chanina: achar arba meot lechureban habbayit, im yomar lecha adam: kach sade shave elef dinarim bedinar echad — lo tikkach. bematnita tana: achar arbaat alafim umatayim usheloshim veachat shana livriat olam, im yomar lecha adam: kach lach sade shave elef dinarim bedinar echad — al tikkach. may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu telat shenin, dematnita tafya telat shene.
Hahu shetara dahava ketiv beh

a: "Shet shenin yattirata", sevur rabbanan kammeh derabba lememar: hay shetar meuchar hu, niakkeveh ad demate zimneh vela taref. amar rav nachman: hay safra davkana katveh, vehanach shet shenin dimlachu beelam, daanan la chashvinan lehu, hu kachashev (leh) [lehu], uvezimneh katveh.
Detanya, rabbi yose omer: shesh shanim malchu beelam, veachar kach pashta malchutan bechol haolam kullo.

Matkef la rav acha bar yaakov: mimmay dilmalchut yevanim manenan? dilma litziat mitzrayim manenan, veshavkeh lealpa kamma venakteh alpa batra, vehay meuchar hu! amar rav nachman: baggola en monin ella lemalche yevanim bilvad.
Hu savar dachoye ka medache leh, nefak dak veashkach, detanya: baggola en monin ella lemalche yevanim bilvad.
Amar ravina: matnitin name dayka, ditnan: "beechad benisan rosh hashshana lammelachim velargalim", veamrinan: lammelachim — lemay hilcheta? amar rav chisda: lishtarot.
Utenan: beechad betishri rosh hashshana lashshanim velashshemittin, veamrinan: lashshanim — lemay hilcheta? veamar rav chisda: lishtarot. kashya shetarot ahadade!
Umeshannenan: kan lemalche yisrael, kan lemalche ummot haolam. lemalche ummot haolam mittishri manenan, lemalche yisrael minnisan manenan.
Vaanan hasheta mittishri manenan, vei salka datach litziat mitzrayim manenan — minnisan baenan lemimne! ella lav shema minna lemalche yevanim manenan? shema minna.

Veyom ginnuseya shel malchehem vechulei. may "veyom ginnuseya shel malchehem"? amar rav yehuda: yom shemmaamidin bo goyim et malkam. vehatanya: yom ginnuseya veyom shemmaamidin bo et malkam! la kashya, ha dideh, ha divreh.

Umi mokmi malka bar malka? vehatane rav yosef: "hinne katon netatticha baggoyim" — sheen moshivin melech ben melech, "bazuy atta meod" — sheen lahen lo ketav velo lashon. ella may yom ginnuseya? yom halleda.
Vehatanya: yom ginnuseya veyom halleda! la kashya: ha dideh, ha divreh.
Vehatanya: yom ginnuseya shello, yom ginnuseya shel beno, veyom halleda shello, veyom halleda shel beno! ella may "yom ginnuseya"? yom shemmaamidin bo malkam, vela kashya — ha dideh, ha divreh.
Vei kashya lach dela mokmi malka bar malka, al yede sheela mokmi, kegon asvirus bar antoninus dimlach.

Amar leh antoninus lerabbi: baena deyimloch asvirus beri techotay, vetitaved teverya kalanya, vei ema lehu chada — avdi, tere — la avdi. ayyti gavra, arkeveh achavreh, vihav leh yona leillay (bideh), vaamar leh letattay: emar (leella dalemaperach) [leillay denafrach] yona min yedeh. amar: shema minna hachi kaamar li: at bei minnayyhu deasvirus beri yimloch techotay", veema leh leasvirus detiaved teverya kalanya.

Amar leh: metzaarin li chashivi romae. [hava] meayyel leh (lageynea) [leginneta], kol yoma akar leh pugela mimmeshara kammeh. amar: shema minna hachi kaamar li — at ketol chad chad minnayyhu, vela titgare behu bechullehu.
b: Velema leh memar [behedya]! amar: shami bi chashivi deromae umetzaaru li. velema leh belachash! mishshum dichtiv: "ki of hashshamayim yolich et hakkol".
Hava leh hahu beratta dishma "gira", kaavda issura. shaddar leh "gargira", shaddar leh "kusebarta", shaddar leh "karate", shelach leh "chassa".

Kol yoma hava (shaddar) [meshaddar] leh dahava pericha bematrata, vechitte appummayyhu. amar lehu: amtiu chitte lerabbi. amar [leh rabbi]: la tzerichna, it li tuva. amar: lihvo leman devatrach, deyahavi levatray deatu batrach, udeate minnayyhu nippok alayyhu.

Hava leh hahi nekirta dahava ayyla mibbeteh levet rabbi, kol yoma hava mayyte tere avde, chad katleh abbava deve rabbi, vechad katleh abbava deveteh. amar leh: beiddana deatena la nashkach gevar kammach.

Yoma chad ashkecheh lerabbi chanina bar chama dahava yatev. amar: la amena lach beiddana deatena la nashkach gevar kammach? amar leh: let den bar inish. amar leh: ema leh lehahu avda degane abbava dekaem velete.

Azal rabbi chanina bar chama, ashkecheh dahava ketil, amar: hechi aaved? i ezil veema leh diktil — en meshivin al hakkalkala, eshbekeh veezil — ka mezalzelna bemalchuta. bea rachame aleh veachyeh veshaddereh. amar: yadana zute deit bechu (machyeh) [mechayye] metim, mihu beiddana deatena la nashkach inish kammach.

Kol yoma hava meshammesh lerabbi, maachel leh, mashke leh. ki hava bae rabbi lemissak lefureya, hava gachen kamme pureya, amar leh: sak illavay lefureyaych. amar leh: lav orach ara lezalzole bemalchuta kulle hay. amar leh: mi yesimeni matztza tachtecha laolam habba.
Amar leh: atena lealma deate? amar leh: in. amar leh: vehachtiv "lo yihye sarid levet esav"! beose maase esav.
Tanya name hachi: "lo yihye sarid levet esav" — yachol lakkol? talmud lomar: "levet esav", beose maase esav.
Amar leh: vehachtiv "shamma edom melacheha vechol nesieha"! amar leh: "melacheha" — velo kol melacheha, "kol nesieha" — velo kol sareha.

Tanya name hachi: "melacheha" velo kol melacheha, "kol nesieha" velo kol sareha. "melacheha" velo kol melacheha — perat leantoninus ben asvirus, "kol nesieha" velo kol sareha — perat liktia bar shalom.
Ketia bar shalom may have? dehahu kesara dahava sane lihudae, amar lehu lachashive demalchuta: mi sheala lo nima beraglo, yiktaenna veyichye o yannichenna veyitztaer? amru lo: yiktaenna veyichye.

Amar lehu ketia bar shalom: chada, dela yachlat lehu lechullehu, dichtiv: "ki kearba ruchot hashshamayim perasti etchem". may kaamar? illema (devaddartehon) [devaddarit yatchon] bearba ruchot, hay "kearba ruchot" — "learba ruchot" mibbee leh! ella, keshem shei efshar laolam belo ruchot, kach i efshar laolam belo yisrael. veod, karu lach malchuta ketia.

Amar leh: memar shappir kaamrat, mihu kol dezache malka shadu leh lekamonya chalila. kad hava naktin leh veazlin, amara leh hahi matronita: vavy leh leilfa deazla bela michsa. nefal al resha deurelteh kattea, amar: yehavit michsay chalefit vaavarit. ki ka shadu leh, amar: kol nichsay lerabbi akiva vachaverav. yatza rabbi akiva vedarash: "vehaya leaharon ulevanav" — mechetza leaharon umechetza levanav.
Yatzta bat kol veamra: ketia bar shalom mezuvmman lechayye haolam habba. bacha rabbi veamar: yesh kone olamo beshaa achat, veyesh kone olamo bechamma shanim.
Antoninus shammesheh lerabbi, addarkan shammesheh lerav. ki shechev antoninus, amar rabbi: nitparda chavila. ki shachev addarkan, amar rav:

a: Nitparda chavila.
Uneklos bar kelonimus iggayyayr, shaddar kesar guneda deromae abbatreh, mashchinhu bikrae, iggayyur. hadar shaddar guneda deromae [acharina] abbatreh, amar lehu: la temru leh vela midde.

Ki havo shakli veazli, amar lehu ema lechu milleta bealma: nifyora naket nura kamme appifyora, appifyora ledukkasa, dukkasa lehegmona, hagemona lekoma, koma mi naket nura mikkamme inashe? amri leh: la. amar lehu: hakkadosh baruch hu nekat nura kamme yisrael, dichtiv: "vaAdonai holech lifnehem yomam vegomer". iggayyur kullehu.
Hadar shaddar guneda acharina abbatreh, amar lehu: la tishtau midde bahadeh. ki nakti leh veazli, chaza mezuzeta demannecha appitcha, otev yedeh ala, vaamar lehu: may hay? amaru leh: ema lan at.

Amar lehu: minhago shel olam, melech basar vadam yoshev mibbifnim, vaavadav meshammerim oto mibbachutz, veillu hakkadosh baruch hu, avadav mibbifnim vehu meshammeran mibbachutz, shenneemar: "Adonai yishmor tzetcha uvoecha meatta vead olam". iggayyur tu la shaddar batreh.

"Vayyomer Adonai lah, shene goyim bevitnech". amar rav yehuda amar rav: al tikre "goyim" ella "geyim", ze antoninus verabbi, shello pasku meal shulechanam lo chazeret velo kishshut velo tzenon, lo bimot hachamma velo bimot haggeshamim, deamar mar: tzenon mechattech ochel, chazeret mehappech maachol, kishshut marchiv meayim.
Veha tana deve rabbi yishmael: lamma nikra sheman kishshuin? mippene shekkashin legufo shel adam kacharavot! la kashya: ha beravreve, ha bezutere.

Yom halleda veyom hammita. mikkelal derabbi meir savar: la shena mita sheyyesh bah serefa, vela shena mita sheen bah serefa — palchi ba laavoda zara, alma serefa lav chukka hi. mikkelal derabbanan savri: serefa chukka hi.
Veha tanya: sorfin al hammelachim, velo middarche haemori, vei chukka hi, anan hechi sarfinan? vehachtiv: "uvechukkotehem lo telechu"!

Ella, dechulle alma serefa lav chukka hi, ella chashivuta hi, vehacha beha kamippalgi: rabbi meir savar — la shena mita sheyyesh bah serefa, vela shena mita sheen bah serefa — palchi ba laavoda zara, verabbanan savri — mita sheyyesh bah serefa chashiva lehu ufalchi ba, vesheen bah serefa la chashiva vela palchi ba.
Gufa: sorfin al hammelachim, veen bo mishshum darche haemori, shenneemar: "beshalom tamut uvemisrefot avotecha hammelachim vegomer", ucheshem shessorfin al hammelachim, kach sorfin al hannesiim.

Uma hem sorfin al hammelachim? mittatan uchele tashmishan, umaase shemmet rabban gamliel hazzaken, vesaraf alav uneklos hagger shivim mane tzori. vehaamrat: ma hen sorfin alehem — mittatan uchele tashmishan! ema: beshivim mane tzori.
Umidde acharina la? vehatanya: okrin al hammelachim, veen bo mishshum darche haemori! amar rav pappa: sus sherachav alav.
Uvehema tehora la? vehatanya: ikkur sheyyesh bah terefa — asur, vesheen bah terefa — muttar, veezehu ikkur sheen bah terefa?
b: Hamenashsher parsoteha min haarkubba ulematta. targema rav pappa: beegla hammoshechet bekaron.

Yom tiglachat zekano. ibbaya lehu, hechi katane? yom tiglachat zekano vehannachat belorito, o dilma yom tiglachat zekano vehaavarat belorito? ta shema, detanya tarvayyhu: yom tiglachat zekano vehannachat belorito, yom tiglachat zekano vehaavarat belorito.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: od acheret yesh [lahem] beromi, achat leshivim shana meviin adam shalem, umarkivin oto al adam chigger, umalbishin oto bigde adam harishon, umannichin lo berosho karkiflo shel rabbi yishmael,

Vetalu leh [betzavvereh] matkal [matan] zuza defizza, umechappin et hashshevavkim beinach, umachrizin lefanav: sach kiri pelaster, achu demarana zayyfana. dechame chame, udela chame la chame, may ahani lerammaa berammauteh ulezayyfana bezayyfanuteh? umesayyeymin ba hachi: vavy leden kad yekum den.
Amar rav ashe: hichshilan pihem larshaim, i amru "zayyfana achu demarana" — kidkaamri, hasheta deamri "demarana zayyfana" — marana gufeh zayyfana hu.
Vetanna didan may tama la kachashev la lehay? deita bechol shatta veshatta kachashev, deleta bechol shatta veshatta la kachashev.
Hane deromae, udefarsae may? muterde vetureyaski, muharneke umuherin. hane defarsae uderomae devavlae may? muharneke veaknita, bachnune vaasar baadar.

Amar rav chanan bar rav chisda amar rav, veamri la amar rav chanan bar rava amar rav: chamishsha batte avoda zara kevuin hen, ellu hen: bet bel bevavel, bet nevo (bechurese) [bevuresif], terata shebbemappag, tzerifa shebbeashkelon, nishra shebbearviyya. ki ata rav dimi hosifu alehen yarid shebbeen bechi, nidbacha shebbeakko. ikka deamri nitbara shebbeakko. rav dimi minnehardea matni ippecha: yarid shebbeakko, nidbacha shebbeen bechi.
Amar leh rav chanan bar rav chisda lerav chisda: may "kevuin hen"? amar leh, hachi amar avu deimmach: kevuin hen leolam. tedira, kulla shatta palchi lehu.

Amar shemuel: baggola eno asur ella yom edam bilvad, veyom edam name mi asir? veha rav yehuda shera leh lerav berona lezabbone chamra, ulerav giddel lezabbone chittin bechaggeta detayyaye! shane chaggeta detayyaye, dela kevia.

Mishna ir sheyyesh bah avoda zara — chutza lah muttar, haya chutza lah avoda zara — tochah lah muttar. mahu lelech lesham? bizman shehadderech meyuchedet leoto makom — asur, veim haya yachol lehallech bah lemakom acher — muttar.

Gemara hechi dame chutza lah? amar rabbi shimon ben lakish mishshum rabbi chanina: kegon itlozah shel azza. veikka deamri, bea minneh rabbi shimon ben lakish merabbi chanina: itlozah shel azza mahu? amar leh: lo halachta letzor miyyamecha veraita yisrael vegoy

a: Sheshshaftu shete kederot al gabbe kira achat? velo chashshu lahem chachamim! may "lo chashshu lahem chachamim"?
Amar abbaye: mishshum besar nevela la amrinan, dilma mahdar appeh yisrael laachoreh veshade goy nevela bikdera, dichvavta hacha name lo chashshu lahem chachamim mishshum deme avoda zara.
Rava amar: may "lo chashshu lahem chachamim"? mishshum bishshule goyim.
Dichvavta, hacha name, lo chashshu lahem chachamim mishshum yom edam.
Rabba bar ulla amar: lo chashshu lahem chachamim mishshum tzinnora.
Dichvavta, hacha name, lo chashshu lahem chachamim mishshum lifne edehen.

Mahu lelech lesham vechulei. tanu rabbanan: ir sheyyesh bah avoda zara — asur likkanes letochah, velo mittochah leir acheret, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: kol zeman shehadderech meyuchedet leoto makom — asur, en hadderech meyuchedet leoto makom — muttar.

Yashav lo kotz bifne avoda zara — lo yishche veyitlenna, mippene shennire kemishtachave laavoda zara, veim eno nire — muttar. nitpazzeru lo meotav bifne avoda zara — lo yishche veyittelem, mippene shennire kemishtachave laavoda zara, veim eno nire — muttar.

Mayayn hammoshech lifne avoda zara — lo yishche veyishte, mippene shennire kemishtachave laavoda zara, veim eno nire — muttar. partzufot hamekallechin mayim lichrakkin — lo yanniach piv al pihem veyishte, mippene shennire kimnashshek laavoda zara. kayyotze bo — lo yanniach piv al silon veyishte, mippene hassakkana.

May "eno nire"? illema dela mitchaze, vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav: kol makom sheasru chachamim mippene marit haayin, afillu bechadre chadarim asur! ella ema: im eno nire kemishtachave laavoda zara — muttar.
Utzericha, dei tena kotz, mishshum deefshar lemezal kammeh umishkeleh, aval maot dela efshar — ema la.
Vei tena maot — demamona, aval kotz detzaara — ema la. vei tena hane tarte — mishshum delekka sakkana, aval mayayn deikka sakkana, dei la shate mayet — ema la. tzericha.
b: Partzufot lema li? mishshum dekavae lemitne: kayyotze vo lo yanniach piv al gabbe hassilon veyishte, mippene hassakkana.
May sakkana? aluka. tanu rabbanan: lo yishte adam mayim lo min hanneharot velo min haagammim, lo befiv velo beyado achat, veim shata — damo berosho, mippene hassakkana. may sakkana? sakkanat aluka.

Mesayyay leh lerabbi chanina, deamar rabbi chanina: habbolea nima shel mayim — muttar lehachem lo chammin beshabbat. umaase beechad shebbala nima shel mayim, vehittir rabbi nechemya lehachem lo chammin beshabbat. addehachi vehachi? amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: ligamma challa.
Amar rav idi bar avin: hay man divla zibbura — michyay la chaye, mihu lashkeyeh reviata dechalla shamgaz, efshar dechaye pureta ad demafked abbeteh.

Tanu rabbanan: lo yishte adam mayim ballayla, veim shata — damo berosho, mippene hassakkana. may sakkana? sakkanat shavrire. veim tzache, may takkanteh? i ikka acharina bahadeh — litreyeh velema leh: "tzachena mayya", vei la — nekarkesh benichtema achatzba, venema ihu lenafsheh: "pelanya bar pelanita, amra lach immach izdehar mishshavrire berire rire yere re bechase chivvare".
Mishna ir sheyyesh bah avoda zara, vehayu bah chanuyot meuttarot vesheenan meuttarot, ze haya maase bevet shean, veamru chachamim: hameuttarot asurot, vesheenan meuttarot muttarot.

Gemara amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: lo shanu ella meuttarot bevevred vahadas, deka mithane merecha, aval meuttarot beferot — muttarot. may tama? deamar kera: "lo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem", nehene hu deasur,

a: Aval mehanne shere. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu meuttarot beferot name asur, kal vachomer: nehene — asur, mehanne — lo kol shekken!

Metivi, rabbi natan omer: yom sheavoda zara mannachat bo et hammeches, machrizin veomrim: kol mi shennotel atara veyanniach berosho uverosh chamoro lichvod avoda zara — yanniach lo et hammeches, veim lav — al yanniach lo et hammeches.
Yehudi shennimtza sham ma yaase? yanniach — nimtza nehene, lo yanniach — nimtza mehanne.

Mikkan amru: hannose venoten beshuk shel avoda zara, behema teaker, perot kesut vechelim yerakvu, maot uchele mattachot yolichem leyam hammelach, veezehu ikkur? hamenashsher parsoteha min haarkubba ulematta.
Katane mihat: yanniach — nimtza nehene, lo yanniach — nimtza mehanne!
Amar rav mesharsheya bereh derav idi: kasavar rabbi shimon ben lakish, peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi natan, vaana daamari kerabbanan difligi aleh. verabbi yochanan savar: la peligi.
Vela peligi? veha tanya: holchin leyarid shel goyim, velokchin mehem behema, avadim ushefachot, battim vesadot ucheramim, vechotev umaale bearkaot shellahen, mippene shehu kematztzil miyyadam.
Veim haya kohen — mittamme bechutza laaretz, ladun ulearer immahem. ucheshem shemmittamme bechutza laaretz, kach mittamme bevet hakkevarot.
Bevet hakkevarot salka datach? tumea deorayyta hi! ella bet happeras derabbanan.
Umetamme lilmod tora velissa ishsha, amar rabbi yehuda: ematay? bizman sheen motze lilmod, aval bizman shemmotze lilmod — eno metamme.
Rabbi yose omer: afillu bizman shemmotze lilmod — yittamme, lefi sheen adam zoche lilmod mikkol.
Amar rabbi yose: maase beyosef hakkohen shehalach achar rabbo letzidon lilmod tora. veamar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi yose.
Alma peligi! amar lach rabbi yochanan: leolam la peligi,
Vela kashya, kan — belokeach min hattaggar, deshakli michsa minneh; kan — belokeach mibbaal habbayit, dela shakli michsa minneh.
Amar mar: behema teaker. veha ikka tzaar baale chayyim! amar abbaye: amar rachamana "et susehem teakker".

Amar mar: veezehu ikkur? menashsher parsoteha min haarkubba ulematta. ureminhi: en makdishin, veen machrimin, veen maarichin bazzeman hazze, veim hikdish vehechrim veheerich — behema teaker, perot kesut vechelim.
b: Yerakvu, maot uchele mattachot — yolichem leyam hammelach, veezehu ikkur? noel delet befaneha, vehi meta meeleha!
Amar abbayye: shane hatam, mishshum bizyon kadashim. venishchateh mishchat! atu behu lide takkala.
Velishavveye gistera! amar abbaye: amar kera "venittatztem et mizbechotam vegomer lo taasun ken laAdonai elohechem".
Rava amar: mippene shennire kemetil mum bekadashim. nire? mum mealleya hu! hane mille bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, dachaze lehakerava. hasheta dela chaze lehakerava — let lan ba.
Velihve kemetil mum bevaal mum, deaf al gav dela chaze lehakerava — asur! baal mum, nehi dela chaze legufeh — lidme chaze, leappoke hacha, dela lidme chaze vela legufeh chaze.

Ashkecheh rabbi yona lerabbi illay dekae appitcha detzor, amar leh: katane "behema teaker", eved may? eved yisrael la ka mibbaya li. ki ka mibbaya li eved goy, may? amar leh: may ka mibbaya lecha? tanya: haggoyim (vaheraveay) [veharoim] behema dakka lo maalin velo moridin.

Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera: katane lokchin mehen behema avadim ushefachot, eved yisrael o dilma afillu eved goy? amar leh: mistabbera eved yisrael, dei eved goy lemay mibbee leh? ki ata ravin amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: afillu eved goy, mippene shemmachniso tachat kanfe hashshechina.
Amar rav ashe: attu behema may "machnis tachat kanfe hashshechina" ikka? ella mishshum miutayyhu, vehacha name dimmaati — shere.

Rabbi yaakov zevan sandala, rabbi yirmeya zevan pitta. amar leh chad lechavreh: yatma, avad rabbach hachi? amar leh iddach: yatma, avad rabbach hachi? vetarvayyhu mibbaal habbayit zevun, vechol chad vechad savar: chavray mittaggar zevan. deamar rabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyyay bar abba: lo shanu ella belokeach min hattaggar, deshakli michsa minneh, aval belokeach mibbaal habbayit, dela shakli minneh michsa — muttar.

Amar rabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyyay bar abba: ilmale haya rabbi yochanan ha zimna beatra deka shakli michsa, afillu mibbaal habbayit hava asar. ella inhu hechi zevun? mibbaal habbayit sheeno kavua zevun.

Mishna ellu devarim asurim limkor legoy: itzterovlin, uvenot shuach, ufetotarot, ulevona, vetarnegol hallavan. rabbi yehuda omer: muttar limkor lo tarnegol lavan ben hattarnegolin, uvizman shehu bifne atzmo — kotea et etzbao umochro lo, lefi sheen makrivim chaser laavoda zara.
Ushear kol haddevarim, setaman muttar, uferushan asur. rabbi meir omer: af dekel tav vechatzav (vanekaleb) [veniklaves] asur limkor laggoyim.

a: Gemara may "itzterovlin"? turenita. ureminhu: hosifu alehen alechsin veitzterovlin, mochsasin uvenot shuach, vei salka datach itzterovlin turenita — turenita mi ita bishviit?
Vehatnan: "ze hakkelal: kol sheyyesh lo ikkar — yesh lo sheviit, vechol sheen lo ikkar — en lo sheviit"! ella amar rav safra: pere dearza, vechen ki ata ravin amar rabbi elazar: pere dearza.
Benot shuach — amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: teene chivvarata. ufetotarot — amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: biftotrotehen shanu.

Levona — amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: levona zakka. tana: umikkullan mochrin lahen chavila, vechamma chavila? peresh rabbi yehuda ben betira: en chavila pechuta mishshelosha manin.
Velechush dilma azel umezabben leacharine umakteri! amar abbaye: allifne" mippakkedinan, allifne" delifne" la mippakkedinan.

Vetarnegol lavan. amar rabbi yona amar rabbi zera amar rav zevid, veikka dematne amar rabbi yona amar rabbi zera: "tarnegol lemi" — muttar limkor lo tarnegol lavan, "tarnegol lavan lemi" — asur limkor lo tarnegol lavan.
Tenan: rabbi yehuda omer: mocher hu lo tarnegol lavan ben hattarnegolin. hechi dame? illema dekaamar: "tarnegol lavan lemi, tarnegol lavan leme" — afillu ben hattarnegolin name la!
Ella lav deka amar "tarnegol lemi, tarnegol lemi", vaafillu hachi, lerabbi yehuda, ben hattarnegolin — in, bifne atzmo — la, uletanna kamma afillu ben hattarnegolin name la!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: hacha bemay askinan? kegon deamar "ze vaze".

Tanya name hachi, amar rabbi yehuda: ematay? bizman sheamar "tarnegol ze lavan", aval im amar "ze vaze" — muttar. vaafillu amar "tarnegol ze", goy sheasa mishte livno o shehaya lo chole betoch beto — muttar.
Vehatanya: goy sheasa mishte livno, eno asur ella oto hayyom veoto haish bilvad. oto hayyom veoto haish miha asur! amar rav yitzchak bar rav mesharsheya: betavvzig.
Tenan: ushear kol haddevarim — setaman muttar, uferushan asur. may setaman umay perushan? illema: setama dekaamar chitte chivvavrata, perushan dekaamar laavoda zara.
b: La setaman tzericha lememar dimzabbeninan, vela perushan tzericha lememar dela mezabbeninan, ella setaman — dekaamar chitte, perushan — dekaamar chivvavrata.
Mikkelal detarnegol, afillu setaman name la! amri: leolam setaman — dekaamar chitte chivvavrata, perushan — dekaamar laavoda zara.

Uferushan itztericha leh, salka datach amena: hay gavra lav laavoda zara ka bae, ella mevak hu daavik baavoda zara, vesavar: ki hechi dehahu gavra avik beh, kulle alma name aviku, ema hachi ki hechi delittevu li, ka mashma lan.
Bae rav ashe: "tarnegol lavan katua lemi", mahu limkor lo tarnegol lavan shalem? mi amrinan: middekaamar "katua", la laavoda zara kavae, o dilma iarome ka maarem?

Im timtze lomar hay iarome hu deka maarem, "tarnegol lavan lemi, tarnegol lavan lemi", vihavu leh shachor ushekal, vihavu leh adom ushekal, mahu limkor lo lavan? mi amrinan: kevan dihavu shachor ushekal, adom ushekal, lav laavoda zara ka bae, o dilma iarome ka maarem? teku.
Rabbi meir omer: af dekel vechulei. amar leh rav chisda laavimi: gemiri daavoda zara deavraham avinu arba mea pirke havyayn, vaanan chamsha tenan, vela yadinan may kaamrinan.

Umay kashya? dekatane: rabbi meir omer af dekel tav, chatzav (vanekales) [veniklaves] asur limkor laggoyim. dekel tav hu dela mezabbeninan, ha dekel bish mezabbeninan? vehatnan: en mochrin lahem bimchubbar lakkarka! amar leh: may "dekel tav"? perot dekel tav. vechen amar rav huna: perot dekel tav.

Chatzav — kashba. (nakelas) [niklaves] — ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi chama bar yosef: kureyayte. amar leh abbaye lerav dimi: tenan (nakelas) [niklaves] vela yadinan mahu, veat amrat kureyayte vela yadinan may ahanet lan! amar leh: ahanay lechu, dechi azlat hatam amrat lehu (nakelas) [niklaves] vela yadi, amrat lehu kureyayte veyadi, veka machvu lach.

Mishna makom shennahagu limkor behema dakka laggoyim — mochrin, makom shennahagu shello limkor — en mochrin. uvechol makom en mochrin lahem behema gassa, agalim useyaychim, shelemin vshvurin. rabbi yehuda mattir bashshevura, uven betira mattir bassus.
Gemara lememra deissura lekka, minhaga hu deikka, hecha dinhig issur — nehug, hecha dinhig hetter — nehug.
Ureminhi: en maamidin behema befunedkaot shel goyim, mippene shechashudin al harvia. amar rav: makom shehittiru limkor — hittiru leyayched, makom sheasru leyayched — asru limkor.

a: Verabbi elazar omer: af bemakom sheasru leyayched, muttar limkor. may tama? goy chas al behemto shello teaker. veaf rav hadar beh, deamar rav tachlifa amar rav shela bar avimi mishshemeh derav: goy chas al behemto shello teaker.
Uvechol makom en mochrin behema gassa kulei. may tama? nehi delirvia la chayyshinan, mebayd bay melacha chayyshinan.
Venebed, kevan dezavna kanyay! gezera mishshum sheela umishshum sechirut.
Shaala kanyay, veagra kanyay!

Ella amar rame bereh derav yeva: gezera mishshum nisyone, dezimnin dezabbena la nihaleh samuch lishkiat hachamma demaale shabbeta, vaamar leh: "ta nasseyay nihaleh", veshama leh lekaleh veazla mechamateh, venicha leh detezil, vehave leh mechammer acher behemto beshabbat, vehamechammer acher behemto beshabbat chayyayv chattat.

Matkef la rav shisha bereh derav idi: usechirut mi kanya? vehatnan: af bemakom sheamru lehasekir — lo levet dira amru, mippene shemmachnis letocho avoda zara. vei salka datach sechirut kanya, hay ki ka meayyel — leveteh ka meayyel!
Shane avoda zara dachamira, dichtiv: "velo tavi toeva el betecha".

Matkef la rav yitzchak bereh derav mesharsheya: usechirut mi kanya? veha tenan: yisrael shessachar para mikkohen — yaachilenna karshinne teruma, vechohen shessachar para miyyisrael, af al pi shemmezonoteha alav — la yaachilenna karshinne teruma.

Vei salka datach sechirut kanya, ammay la yaachilenna? para dideh hi! ella shema minna sechirut la kanya. vehasheta deamrat sechirut la kanya, gezera mishshum sechirut, ugezera mishshum sheela, ugezera mishshum nisyone.

Rav adda shera lezabbone chamara ayyeda desafsira, i mishshum nisyone — ha la yada lekaleh deazla mechamateh, vei mishshum sheela usechirut — kevan dela dideh hi la moshel vela mogar, veod — mishshum dela nigalle beh muma.
Rav huna zabben hahi para legoy. amar leh rav chisda: may tama avad mar hachi? amar leh: emor lishchita zavna.
b: Umena temra deamrinan ki hay gavvna? ditnan: bet shammay omrim: lo yimkor adam para hachoreshet bashsheviit, uvet hillel mattirin, mippene sheyyachol leshochtah.
Amar rabba: mi dame? hatam en adam metzvvev al shevitat behemto bashsheviit, hacha adam metzvvev al shevitat behemto bashshabbat.

Amar leh abbaye: vechol hecha deadam metzvvev asur? vahare sade, deadam metzvvev al shevitat sadehu bashsheviit, utenan: bet shammay omrim: lo yimkor adam sede nir bashsheviit, uvet hillel mattirin, mippene sheyyachol lehovirah!

Matkef la rav ashe: vechol hecha deen adam metzvvev — shere? vahare kelim, deen adam metzvvev al shevitat kelim bishviit, utenan: ellu hen kelim sheen adam rashshay lemochran bashsheviit: hammachresha vechol keleha, haol, vehammizre, vehaddeker!
Ella amar rav ashe: kol hecha deikka lemitle talenan, veaf al gav dimtzvvev, vechol hecha delekka lemitle — la talenan, af al gav deeno metzvvev.

Rabba zabben hahu chamara leyisrael hechashud limkor legoy, amar leh abbaye: may tama aved mar hachi? amar leh: ana leyisrael zabbeni. amar leh: veha azel umezabben leh legoy! legoy ka mezabben, leyisrael la ka mezabben?

Etiveh: makom shennahagu limkor behema dakka lakkutim — mochrin, shello limkor — en mochrin. may tama? illema mishshum dachashidi arvia, umi chashidi? vehatanya: en maamidin behema befunedkaot shel goyim, zecharim etzel zecharim, unekevot etzel nekevot, veen tzarich lomar nekevot etzel zecharim uzecharim etzel nekevot.

Veen mosrin behema laroe shellahen, veen meyaychadin immahem, veen mosrin lahem tinok lelammedo sefer ulelammedo ummanut, aval maamidin behema befunedkaot shel kutim, zecharim etzel nekevot unekevot etzel zecharim, veen tzarich lomar zecharim etzel zecharim unekevot etzel nekevot.
Umosrin behema laroe shellahen, umeyaychadin immahem, umosrin lahem tinok lelammedo sefer ulelammedo ummanut; alma la chashidi.
Veod tanya: en mochrin lahem lo zayin velo kele zayin, veen mashchizin lahen et hazzayin, veen mochrin lahen lo saddan velo kolarin velo kevalim velo shalshelaot shel barzel, echad goy veechad kuti.
May tama? i nema dachashidi ashshefichut damim, umi chashidi? haamrat: umeyaychadin immahen! ella mishshum deate lezabbona legoy.

Vechi tema: kuti la aved teshuva, yisrael aved teshuva, vehaamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: kederech sheamru asur limkor legoy, kach asur limkor leyisrael hechashud limkor legoy! rehayt batreh telata parse, veikka deamri: parsa bechala, vela adrecheh.
Amar rav dimi bar abba: kederech sheasur limkor legoy, asur limkor lelistim yisrael. hechi dame? i dachashid dekatel — peshita, hayeynu goy.
Vei dela katel, ammay la? leolam dela katel, vehacha bemay askinan? bemashmota, dezimnin deaved leatztzole nafsheh.
Tanu rabbanan: en mochrin lahen terisin, veyesh omrim: mochrin lahen terisin. may tama? illema mishshum demaggenu alayyhu, i hachi, afillu chitte useare name la! amar rav:

a: I efshar, hachi name.

Ikka deamri: terisin hayeynu tama dela, dechi shelim zenayyhu katli begavvayyhu. veyesh omrim: mochrim lahem terisin, dechi shelim zenayyhu mirak orki. amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: halacha keyesh omrim.

Amar rav adda bar ahava: en mochrin lahen ashashiyyot shel barzel, may tama? mishshum dechalshi minnayyhu kele zayin. i hachi, afillu mare vachatzine name! amar rav zevid: befarzela hindua. vehaiddana deka mezabbeninan, amar rav ashe: lefarsae demaggenu illavavn.

Agalim useyaychim. tanya: rabbi yehuda mattir bishvura, mippene sheenah yechola lehitrappeot velichyot. amru lo: vahalo marbiin aleha veyoledet, vechevan demarbiin aleha veyoledet atu leshahoya. amar lahen: lichshetteled. alma la (mekabbelet) [mekabbela] zachar.

Ben betira mattir bassus. tanya: ben betira mattir bassus, mippene shehu ose bo melacha sheen chayyayvin aleha chattat. verabbi oser mippene shene devarim: echad mishshum torat kele zayin, veechad mishshum torat behema gassa.
Bishlama torat kele zayin ikka, dekatel besichufeh, ella torat behema gassa may hi? amar rabbi yochanan: lichsheyyazkin matchino berechayim beshabbat. amar rabbi yochanan: halacha keven betira.
Ibbaya lehu: shor shel pattam mahu? tibbee lerabbi yehuda, tibbee lerabbanan.
Tibbee lerabbi yehuda: ad kan la ka share rabbi yehuda ella bishvura, dela ate lichlal melacha, aval hay dechi meshahe leh ate lichlal melacha — asur.
O dilma, afillu lerabbanan la ka asri hatam ella distameh lav lishchita kae, aval hay distameh lishchita kae — afillu rabbanan sharu?

Ta shema, deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shel bet rabbi hayu makrivin shor shel pattam beyom edam, chaser arba rivvan sheen makrivin oto hayyom ella lemachar, chaser arba rivvan sheen makrivin oto chay ella shachut, chaser arba rivvan sheen makrivin oto kol ikkar.
May tama, lav mishshum dilma ate leshahoye? velitamaych, sheen makrivin oto hayyom ella lemachar — may tama? ella, rabbi mikar milleta bae, vesavar: yiakar veate pureta pureta.
Vechi meshahe leh bare veaved melacha? amar rav ashe: amar li zevida bar tora, meshahenan leh veaved al chad teren.

Mishna en mochrin lahem dubbin vaarayot vechol davar sheyyesh bo nezek larabbim. en bonin immahem basilke, gardom, itztadyay, uvima, aval bonin immahem bimosyaot uvet merchatzaot. higgia lechippa shemmaamidin bah avoda zara — asur livnot.
Gemara amar rav chanin bar rav chisda, veamri la amar rav chanan bar rava amar rav: chayya gassa hare hi kivhema dakka lefirkus, aval lo limchira.
Vaani omer: af limchira, makom shennahagu limkor — mochrin, shello limkor — en mochrin.
Tenan: en mochrin lahen dubbin vaarayot velo kol davar sheyyesh bo nezek larabbim. tama deit beh nezek larabbim, ha let beh nezek larabbim — shere! amar rabba bar ulla: baari shavur,
b: Veallibba derabbi yehuda. rav ashe amar: setam ari shavur hu etzel melacha.

Metivi: keshem sheen mochrin lahen behema gassa, kach en mochrin lahen chayya gassa, vaafillu bimkom shemmochrin lahen behema dakka — chayya gassa en mochrin lahen. teyuveta derav chanan bar rava, teyuveta.
Ravina rame matnitin abbarayyta umeshanne, tenan: en mochrin lahen dubbin vaarayot velo kol davar sheyyesh bo nezek larabbim, tama deit beh nezek, ha let beh nezek — mochrin.

Ureminhi: keshem sheen mochrin behema gassa, kach en mochrin chayya gassa, vaafillu bimkom shemmochrin behema dakka, chayya gassa en mochrin. umeshanne: baari shavur, veallibba derabbi yehuda. rav ashe amar: setam ari shavur hu etzel melacha.
Matkef la rav nachman: man lema lan daari chayya gassa hi? dilma chayya dakka hi!
Rav ashe dayek matnitin umotev teyuveta, tenan: en mochrin lahen dubbim vaarayot velo kol davar sheyyesh bo nezek larabbim. tama deit beh nezek, ha let beh nezek mochrin.
Vetama ari, distam ari shavur hu etzel melacha, aval midde acharina deaved melacha — la. teyuveta derav chanan bar rava, teyuveta.
Vechayya gassa mihat may melacha avda? amar abbaye: amar li mar yehuda, deve mar yochani tachani rechayim baarode.
Amar rabbi zera: ki havenan be rav yehuda, amar lan: gemiru minnay ha milleta, demiggavra rabba shemia li, vela yadana i merav i mishshemuel: chayya gassa hare hi kivhema dakka lefirkus.

Ki atay lekurekuneya, ashkachteh lerav chiyyay bar ashe, veyatev vekaamar mishshemeh dishmuel: chayya gassa hare hi kivhema dakka lefirkus. amena: shema minna mishshemeh dishmuel ittemar. ki atay lesura, ashkachteh lerabba bar yirmeya deyatev vekaamar la mishshemeh derav: chayya gassa hare hi kivhema dakka lefirkus. amena: shema minna ittemar mishshemeh derav veittemar mishshemeh dishmuel.

Ki selekit lehatam, ashkachteh lerav assi deyatev vekaamar: amar rav chama bar gureya mishshemeh derav: chayya gassa hare hi kivhema dakka lefirkus. amari leh: vela savar la mar deman mara dishmateta rabba bar yirmeya? amar li: patya ukkama, minnay uminnach tistayyem shemata.
Ittemar name: amar rabbi zera, amar rav assi, amar rabba bar yirmeya, amar rav chama bar gureya, amar rav: chayya gassa hare hi kivhema dakka lefirkus.

En bonin kulei. amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: shalosh basilkaot hen, shel melachim, veshel merchatzaot, veshel otzarot. amar rava: shetayim lehetter veechad leissur, vesiman: "lesor malchehem bezikkim".
Veikka deamri, amar rava: kullam lehetter. vehatnan: en bonin immahen basilke, gardom, itztadyay uvima! ema: shel gardom veshel itztadyay veshel bima.
Tanu rabbanan: keshennitpas rabbi eliezer leminut, heeluhu laggardom liddon. amar lo oto hegmon: zaken shekkemotcha yaasok bidvarim betelim hallalu?
Amar lo: neeman alay haddayyayn. kesavur oto hegmon: alav hu omer, vehu lo amar ella keneged aviv shebbashshamayim. amar lo: hoil veheemanti alecha, dimos — patur atta.

Keshebba leveto, nichnesu talmidav etzlo lenachamo, velo kibbel alav tanchumin. amar lo rabbi akiva: rabbi, tarsheni lomar davar echad mimma shellimmadtani? amar lo: emor. amar lo: rabbi, shemma minut ba leyadcha

a: Vehinacha, vealav nitpasta? amar lo: akiva, hizkartani, paam achat hayiti mehallech bashshuk haelyon shel tzippori, umatzati adam echad mittalmide yeshu hannotzri, veyaakov ish kefar sechanya shemo. amar li: katuv betoratchem: "lo tavi etnan zona vegomer", mahu laasot hemennu bet hakkisse lechohen gadol? velo amarti lo kelum.
Amar li: kach limmedani yeshu hannotzri, ki "meetnan zona kubbatza vead etnan zona yashuvu", mimmekom hattinnofet bau, limkom hattinnofet yelechu.

Vehinani haddavar, al yede ze nitpasti leminut, veavarti al ma shekkatuv battora: "harechek mealeha darkecha" — zo minut, "veal tikrav el petach betah" — zo harashut. veikka deamri: "harechek mealeha darkecha" — zo minut veharashut, "veal tikrav el petach betah" — zo zona. vechamma? amar rav chisda: arba ammot.

Verabbanan [hay] "meetnan zona" may darshi beh? kidrav chisda, deamar rav chisda: kol zona shenniskeret, levassof hi socheret, shenneemar: "uvetittech etnan veetnan lo nittan lach [vattehi lehefech]".
Ufeliga derabbi pedat, deamar rabbi pedat: lo asra tora ella keriva shel gilluy arayot bilvad, shenneemar: "ish ish el kol sheer besaro lo tikrevu legallot erva".

Ulla ki hava ate mibbe rav, hava menashshek lehu laachateh abbe yedayyhu, veamri la: abbe chadayyhu. ufeliga dideh addideh, deamar ulla: keriva bealma asur, mishshum "lach lach, amrin nezira; sechor sechor, lecharma la tikrav".

"Laaluka shete vanot hav hav". may "hav hav"? amar mar ukeva: [kol] shete banot shetztzoakot miggehinnam, veomrot baolam hazze "have have". uman ninhu? minut veharashut. ikka deamri: amar rav chisda amar mar ukeva, kol gehinnam tzoeket veomeret: haviu li shete banot shetztzoakot veomrot baolam hazze "have have".
"Kol baeha lo yeshuvun velo yassigu orchot chayyim", vechi meachar shello shavu, hechan yassigu? hachi kaamar: veim yashuvu — lo yassigu orchot chayyim.

Lememra, dechol happoresh mimminut mayet? veha hahi daatay lekammeh derav chisda, veamra leh: kalla shebbakkallot asta benah hakkatan mibbenah haggadol, vaamar la rav chisda: terachu la bizvavdta, vela mita.
Middekaamra kalla shebbakkallot asta, mikkelal deminut [name] havya ba! hahu dela hadra ba shappir, umishshum hachi lo meta.

Ikka deamri: mimminut — in, meavera — la? veha hahi daatay kammeh derav chisda, vaamar lehu [rav chisda: zavvidu la zevavdta], umita! middekaamra "kalla shebbakkallot", mikkelal deminut name haveya ba.

Umeavera la? vehatanya: amru alav al rabbi elazar ben duredya, shello hinniach zona achat baolam shello ba aleha. paam achat shama sheyyesh zona achat bichrakke hayyam, vehayta notelet kis dinarin bischarah. natal kis dinarin vehalach veavar aleha shiva neharot. bishat hergel davar heficha, amra: keshem shehafaycha zo enah chozeret limkomah, kach elazar ben duredya en mekabbelin oto bitshuva.

Halach veyashav ben shene harim ugevaot, amar: harim ugevaot bakkeshu alay rachamim! amru lo: ad sheanu mevakkeshim alecha nevakkesh al atzmenu, shenneemar: "ki heharim yamushu vehaggevaot temutena". amar: shamayim vaaretz bakkeshu alay rachamim! amru: ad sheanu mevakkeshim alecha nevakkesh al atzmenu, shenneemar: "ki shamayim keashan nimlachu vehaaretz kabbeged tivle".

Amar: chamma ulevana bakkeshu alay rachamim! amru lo: ad sheanu mevakkeshim alecha, nevakkesh al atzmenu, shenneemar: "vechafra hallevana uvosha hachamma". amar: kochavim umazzalot bakkeshu alay rachamim! amru lo: ad sheanu mevakkeshim alecha, nevakkesh al atzmenu, shenneemar: "venamakku kol tzeva hashshamayim".

Amar: en haddavar taluy ella bi. hinniach rosho ben birkav vegaa bivchiyya ad sheyyatzta nishmato. yatzta bat kol veamra: rabbi elazar ben duredya mezuvmman lechayye haolam habba! [veha hacha baavera hava umit], hatam name, kevan daavik ba tuva, keminut damya.
Bacha rabbi veamar: yesh kone olamo bechamma shanim, veyesh kone olamo beshaa achat. veamar rabbi: lo dayyayn levaale teshuva shemmekabbelin otan, ella shekkorin otan "rabbi".
Rabbi chanina verabbi yonatan havo kaazli beorcha, meto lehanhu tere shevile, chad patze appitcha daavoda zara, vechad patze appitcha deve zonot. amar leh chad lechavreh: nezil appitcha daavoda zara
b: Dinchis yitzreh. amar leh iddach: nezil appitcha deve zonot venichpeyeh leyitzrin unekabbel agra. ki matu hatam, chazonhu [lezonot], itkenau mikkammayyhu.
Amar leh: mena lach ha? amar leh: "mezimma tishmor alecha tevuna tintzerekka".

Amaru leh rabbanan lerava: may "mezimma"? ilema tora, dichtiv ba "zimma" umetargeminan: etzat chitin, uchetiv: "hifli etza higdil tushiyya". i hachi, "zimma" mibbee leh! hachi kaamar: middevar zimma tishmor alecha, tora tintzerekka.

Tanu rabbanan: keshennitpesu rabbi elazar ben parta verabbi chanina ben teradyon, amar lo rabbi elazar ben parta lerabbi chanina ben teradyon: ashrecha shennitpasta al davar echad, oy li shennitpasti al chamishsha devarim.

Amar lo rabbi chanina: ashrecha shennitpasta al chamishsha devarim veatta nitztzol, oy li shennitpasti al davar echad veeni nitztzol, sheatta asakta battora uvigmilut chasadim, vaani lo asakti ella battora [bilvad].

Vechidrav huna, deamar rav huna: kol haosek battora bilvad dome kemi sheen lo eloah, shenneemar: "veyamim rabbim leyisrael lelo elohe emet vegomer". may "lelo elohe emet"? shekkol haosek battora bilvad dome kemi sheen lo eloah.

Uvigmilut chasadim lo asak? vehatanya: rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: lo yitten adam meotav learnaki shel tzedaka ella im ken memunne alav talmid chacham kerabbi chanina ben teradyon! (hemnu) [hemone] hu dahava meheman, mebad la avad.
Vehatanya, amar lo: maot shel purim nitchallefu li bemaot shel tzedaka vechillaktim laaniyyim! mebad avad, kidvae leh la avad.

Atyu lerabbi elazar ben parta, amaru: may tama tanet, umay tama ganvat? amar lehu: i sayyayfa la safra, vei safra la sayyayfa, umiddeha leta ha name leta. umay tama karu lach "rabbi"? rabban shel tarsiyyim ani.
Ayyto leh tere kibbure, amaru leh: he deshitya vehe deirba? itrechish leh nissa, (atya) [atay] zibburita ittiv al deshitya, vaatay zibbura vitev al deirba. amar lehu: hay deshitya vehay deirba.
Amaru leh: umay tama la atet leve avidan? amar lehu: zaken hayiti umityayre ani shemma tirmesuni beraglechem. [amaru]: vead haiddana kamma save itremus? itrechish nissa, hahu yoma irmas chad sava.

Umay tama ka shavkat avdach lecherut? amar lehu: lo hayu devarim meolam. kam chad [minnayyhu] leashode beh, ata eliyyahu iddemi leh kechad mechashshivve demalchuta, amar leh: middeitrechish leh nissa bechullehu, beha name itrechish leh nissa, vehahu gavra bishuteh hu deka (achvi) [machve].

Vela ashgach beh, kam lememar lehu. hava ketiva iggarta, dahava ketiv mechashshive demalchut leshaddore leve kesar, veshadderuha al yedeh dehahu gavra. ata eliyyahu patkeh arba mea parse, azal vela ata.

Atyu lerabbi chanina ben teradyon, amaru leh: ammay ka askat beorayyta? amar lehu: "kaasher tzivvani Adonai elohay". miyyad gazru alav lisrefa, veal ishto lahariga, veal bitto leshev bekubba shel zonot. alav lisrefa — shehaya

a: Hoge et hashshem beotiyyotav. vehechi aved hachi? vehatnan: ellu sheen lahem chelek laolam habba — haomer en tora min hashshamayim, veen techiyyayt hammetim min hattora. abba shaul omer: af hahoge et hashshem beotiyyotav!
Lehitlammed avad, kidtanya: "lo tilmad laasot", aval atta lamed lehavin ulehorot.
Ella may tama ianash? mishshum (hoga) [dehoge] et hashshem befarhesya [hava], veal ishto lahariga dela (maycha) [machata] beh. mikkan amru: kol mi sheyyesh beyado limchot veeno moche neenash alav.

Veal bitto leshev bekubba shel zonot, deamar rabbi yochanan: paam achat hayta bitto mehallechet lifne gedole romi, amru: kamma naot pesioteha shel riva zo, miyyad dikdeka bifsioteha. vehayeynu deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish: may dichtiv "avon akevay yesubbeni"? avonot sheadam dash baakevav baolam hazze mesubbin lo leyom haddin.

Beshaa sheyyatzu shelashtan, tziddeku alehem et haddin, hu amar: "hatztzur tamim poolo [vegomer]", veishto amra: "el emuna veen avel", bitto amra: "gedol haetza verav haaliliyya asher enecha fekuchot al kol darche vegomer", amar rabbi: [kamma] gedolim tzaddikim hallalu, shennizdammenu lahen shalosh mikraot shel tzidduk haddin bishat tzidduk haddin.

Tanu rabbanan: keshechala rabbi yose ben kisma, halach rabbi chanina ben teradyon levakkero. amar lo: chanina achi, (achi), i atta yodea sheumma zo min hashshamayim himlichuha? shehechriva et beto vesarfa et hechalo, veharga et chasidav veibbeda et tovav, vaadayin hi kayyemet. vaani shamati alecha sheatta yoshev veosek battora [umakhil kehillot barabbim], vesefer munnach lecha bechekecha!

Amar lo: min hashshamayim yerachamu. amar lo: ani omer lecha devarim shel taam, veatta omer li "min hashshamayim yerachamu"? tameah ani im lo yisrefu otcha veet sefer tora baesh! amar lo: rabbi, ma ani lechayye haolam habba?
Amar lo: kelum maase ba leyadecha? amar lo: maot shel purim nitchallefu li bemaot shel tzedaka vechillaktim laaniyyim. amar lo: im ken, mechelkecha yehi chelki umiggoralcha yehi gorali.

Amru: lo hayu yamim muatim ad shenniftar rabbi yose ben kisma, vehalchu kol gedole romi lekovro vehispiduhu hesped gadol, uvachazaratan metzauhu lerabbi chanina ben teradyon shehaya yoshev veosek battora umakhil kehillot barabbim vesefer tora munnach lo becheko.

Heviuhu ucherachuhu besefer tora, vehikkifuhu bachavile zemorot vehitztzitu bahen et haur, veheviu sefogin shel tzemer usheraum bemayim vehinnichum al libbo, kede shello tetze nishmato mehera. amra lo bitto: abba, eracha bechach? amar la: ilmale ani nisrafti levaddi haya haddavar kashe li, achshav sheani nisraf vesefer tora immi, mi shemvakkesh elbonah shel sefer tora hu yevakkesh elboni.

Amru lo talmidav: rabbi, ma atta roe? amar lahen: (gilyon) [gevilin] nisrafin veotiyyot porchot. af atta petach picha vetikkanes becha haesh. amar lahen: mutav sheyyittelenna mi shennetanah, veal yechabbel hu beatzmo.

Amar lo kelatztoneri: rabbi, im ani marbe bashshalhevet venotel sefogin shel tzemer meal libbecha, atta mevieni lechayye haolam habba? amar lo: hen. hishshava li, nishba lo. miyyad hirba bashshalhevet venatal sefogin shel tzemer meal libbo, yatza nishmato bimhera. af hu kafatz venafal letoch haur.
Yatza bat kol veamra: rabbi chanina ben teradyon ukelatztoneri mezummanin hen lechayye haolam habba. bacha rabbi veamar: yesh kone olamo beshaa achat, veyesh kone olamo bechamma shanim.

Berureya devethu derabbi meir, beratte derabbi chanina ben teradyon havay, amara leh: zila bi milleta deyatva achatay bekubba shel zonot. shekal tarkabba dedinare vaazal, amar: i la itavid ba issura — (mitavid) [mitrechish] nissa, i avada issura — la (itavid) [mitrechish] la nissa.

Azal nekat nafsheh kechad parasha, amar la: (hashemiini) [hishshami] li. amara leh: dashtana ana. amar la: mittarachna (mirtach). amara leh: nefishan tuva (veikka tuva hacha) deshappiran minnay. amar: shema minna la avada issura, kol deate amra leh hachi.

Azal legabbe shomer dida, amar leh: hava nihalay, amar leh: mistefena mimmalchuta, amar leh: shekol tarkabba dedinare, palga pelach ufalga leheve lach, amar leh: vechi shalmi may ebed? amar leh: ema "elaha demeir aneni" umittatztzelat, amar leh:
b: Umi yemar dehachi ikka? amar leh: hasheta chazet. havo hanhu kalve dahavo ka achli inashe, shekal kala sheda behu. havo kaatu lemechleh, amar: "elaha demeir aneni!", shavku, veyahava leh.
Lesof ishtema milleta be malka, atyu asseku lizkifa. amar: "elaha demeir aneni!" achatu. amaru leh: may hay? amar lehu: hachi hava maase.

Ato chakaku lidmuteh derabbi meir appitcha deromi, amri: kol dechaze lefartzufa haden layyteh. yoma chada chazyuhi, rehut abbatreh, rehat mikkammayyhu, al leve zonot. ikka deamri: bishshule goyim chaza, temash beha umetak beha. ikka deamri: ata eliyyahu iddemi lehu kezona, kerachteh. amri: chas veshalom, i rabbi meir hava la hava aved hachi.
Kam arak, ata levavel. ikka deamri: mehay maase, veikka deamri: mimmaase divrureya.

Tanu rabbanan: haholech leitztadinin ulecharkom, veraa sham et hannechashim veet hachabbarin, bukeyon umukeyon umuleyon veluleyon, belurin salgurin — hare ze moshav letzim, vaalehem hakkatuv omer: "ashre haish asher lo halach vegomer ki im betorat Adonai cheftzo", ha lamadta sheddevarim hallalu meviin et haadam lide bittul tora.

Ureminhi: leitztadinin muttar, mippene shetztzoveach umatztzil, ulecharkom muttar, mippene yishshuv medina, uvilvad shello yitchashshev immahem, veim nitchashshev immahem — asur. kashya itztedinin aitztadinin, kashya karkom akkarkom!
Bishlama karkom akkarkom la kashya, kan — bemitchashshev immahen, kan — besheen mitchashshev immahen, ella itztadinin aitztadinin kashya!

Tannae hi, detanya: en holchin leitztadinin mippene "moshav letzim", verabbi natan mattir mippene shene devarim: echad, mippene shetztzoveach umatztzil, veechad, mippene shemmeid edut ishsha lehassiah.

Tanu rabbanan: en holchin leteratyaot ulekirkesiot, mippene shemmezabbelin sham zibbul laavoda zara, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: makom shemmezabbelin — asur mippene chashad avoda zara, umakom sheen mezabbelin sham — asur mippene "moshav letzim".
May benayyhu? amar rabbi chanina missura: nasa venatan ikka benayyhu.

Derash rabbi shimon ben pazzi: may dichtiv "ashre haish asher lo halach baatzat reshaim uvederech chattaim lo amad uvemoshav letzim lo yashav"? vechi meachar shello halach, hechan amad? umeachar shello amad, hechan yashav? umeachar shello yeshev, hechan latz?
Ella lomar lach, sheim halach — sofo laamod, veim amad — sofo leshev, veim yashav — sofo lalutz, veim latz — alav hakkatuv omer: "im chachamta chachamta lach veim latzta levaddecha tissa".

Amar rabbi eliezer: kol hammitlotzetz yissurin bain alav, shenneemar: "veatta al titlotzatzu pen yechzeku mosrechem". amar lehu rava lerabbanan: bematuta baena minnayychu dela titlotztzu, dela leto alayychu yissurin.

Amar rav kattina: kol hammitlotzetz mezonotav mitmaatin, shenneemar: "mashach yado et lotztzim". amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: kol hammitlotzetz nofel begehinnam, shenneemar: "zed yahir letz shemo ose beevrat zadon", veen evra ella gehinnam, shenneemar: "yom evra hayyom hahu".

Amar rabbi oshaya: kol hammityayher nofel begehinnam, shenneemar: "zed yahir letz shemo ose beevrat zadon", veen evra ella gehinnam, shenneemar: "yom evra hayyom hahu". amar rabbi chanilay bar chanilay: kol hammitlotzetz gorem kelayay laolam, shenneemar: "veatta al titlotzatzu pen yechzeku mosrechem ki chala venecheratza shamati".

Amar rabbi eliezer: kasha hi shettechillato yissurin vesofo kelayay. darash rabbi shimon ben pazzi: "ashre haish asher lo halach" leteratyaot ulekirkesiot shel goyim, "uvederech chattaim lo amad" — ze shello amad bekinigyon, "uvemoshav letzim lo yashav" — shello yashav betachbulot.
Shemma yomar adam: hoil velo halachti leteratyaot ulekirkesiot velo amadti bekinigyon, elech veetgare beshena, talmud lomar: "uvetorato yehge yomam valayla".
Amar rav shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: "ashre haish asher lo halach baatzat reshaim" — ze

a: Avraham avinu, shello halach baatzat anshe dor happelagga, shershaim hayu, shenneemar: "hava nivne lanu ir", "uvederech chattaim lo amad" — shello amad baamidat sedom, shechataim hayu, shenneemar: "veanshe sedom raim vechattaim laAdonai meod".
"Uvemoshav letzim lo yashav" — shello yashav bemoshav anshe pelishtim, mippene shelletzanim hayu, shenneemar: "vayhi ketov libbam vayyomru kiru leshimshon visachek lanu".
"Ashre ish yare et Adonai", ashre ish velo ashre ishsha? amar rav amram amar rav: ashre mi sheose teshuva keshehu "ish". rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: ashre mi shemmitgabber al yitzro "keish".

"Bemitzvotav chafetz meod", amar rabbi elazar: "bemitzvotav" velo bischar mitzvotav, vehayeynu ditnan: hu haya omer: al tihyu kaavadim hameshammeshin et harav al menat lekabbel peras, ella heyu kaavadim hameshammeshin et harav shello al menat lekabbel peras.
"Ki im betorat Adonai cheftzo", amar rabbi: en adam lomed tora ella mimmakom shellibbo chafetz, shenneemar: "ki im betorat Adonai cheftzo".

Levi verabbi shimon berabbi yatvi kammeh derabbi, veka paski sidra. selek sifra, levi amar: layyto [lan] mishle, rabbi shimon berabbi amar: layyto [lan] tillim. kafyeh lelevi veayyto tillim, ki meto hacha "ki im betorat Adonai cheftzo", paresh rabbi vaamar: en adam lomed tora ella mimmakom shellibbo chafetz. amar levi: rabbi, natatta lanu reshut laamod.

Amar rabbi avdimi bar chama: kol haosek battora, hakkadosh baruch hu ose lo chafatzav, shenneemar: "ki im betorat Adonai cheftzo". amar rava: leolam yilmod adam tora bemakom shellibbo chafetz, shenneemar: "ki im betorat Adonai cheftzo".
Veamar rava: battechilla nikret al shemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu, ulevassof nikret al shemo, shenneemar: "betorat Adonai cheftzo", "uvetorato yehge yomam valayla".
Veamar rava: leolam yilmad adam tora, veachar kach yehege, shenneemar: "betorat Adonai", vahadar "uvetorato yehge".
Veamar rava: leolam ligres inish, veaf al gav dimshakkach, veaf al gav dela yada may kaamar, shenneemar: "garsa nafshi letaava", "garsa" ketiv vela ketiv "tachana".
Rava rame: ketiv "al gappe", uchetiv "al kisse"! battechilla "al gappe", ulevassof "al kisse".
Ketiv "berosh meromim", uchetiv "ale darech". battechilla "berosh meromim", ulevassof "ale darech".
Ulla rame: ketiv "shete mayim mibborecha", uchetiv "venozlim mittoch beerecha" — battechilla "shete mibborecha", ulevassof "venozlim mittoch beerecha".
Amar rava amar rav sechora amar rav huna: may dichtiv "hon mehevel yimat vekovetz al yad yarbe"? im ose adam torato chavilot chavilot — mitmaet, veim kovetz al yad — yarbe.
Amar rava: yadi rabbanan leha milleta veavri ala. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: ana avidta, veikkayyaym bidi.
Amar rav shezvi mishshemeh derabbi elazar ben azarya: may dichtiv "lo yacharoch remiyya tzedo"? lo yichye velo yaarich yamim tzayyayd harammay.

Verav sheshet amar: "tzayyayd harammay yacharoch". ki ata rav dimi amar: mashal leadam shetztzad tzipporin, im meshabber kenafeha shel rishona — kullam mitkayyeymot beyado, veim lav — en mitkayyeymot beyado.
"Vehaya keetz shatul al palge mayim", amri deve rabbi yannay: "keetz shatul" velo "keetz natua", kol hallomed tora merav echad eno roe siman beracha leolam.

Amar lehu rav chisda lerabbanan: baena deema lechu milleta, umistefena deshavkitu li veazlitu. kol hallomed tora merav echad — eno roe siman beracha leolam. shavku vaazul kammeh derava. amar lehu: hane mille sevara, aval gemara merav echad adif, ki hechi
b: Dela lippallug lishshane. "al palge mayim". amar rabbi tanchum bar chanilay: leolam yeshallesh adam shenotav — shelish bammikra, shelish bammishna, shelish battalmud.
Mi yada inish kamma chaye? ki kaamrinan — beyome.
"Asher piryo yitten beitto", amar rava: im "piryo yitten beitto" — "vealehu lo yibbol", veim lav — al hallomed veal hamelammed alehem hakkatuv omer: "lo chen harshaim ki im vegomer".
Amar rabbi abba amar rav huna amar rav, may dichtiv: "ki rabbim chalalim hippila" — ze talmid shello higgia lehoraa umore, "vaatzumim kol harugeha" — ze talmid shehiggia lehoraa veeno more.
Vead kamma? ad arbein shenin. veha rava ori! hatam beshavin.

"Vealehu lo yibbol", amar rav acha bar adda amar rav, veamri la amar rav acha bar abba amar rav hamenuna amar rav: sheafillu sichat chullin shel talmide chachamim tzericha talmud, shenneemar: "vealehu lo yibbol".

"Vechol asher yaase yatzliach", amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: davar ze katuv battora, veshanuy banneviim, umeshullash bakketuvim — kol haosek battora nechasav matzlichin lo. katuv battora — dichtiv: "ushemartem et divre habberit hazzot vaasitem otam lemaan taskilu et kol asher taasun".

Shanuy banneviim — dichtiv: "lo yamush sefer hattora [hazze] mippicha vehagita bo yomam valayla lemaan tishmor laasot kechol hakkatuv bo ki az tatzliach et derachecha veaz taskil". meshullash bakketuvim — dichtiv: "ki im betorat Adonai cheftzo uvetorato yehge yomam valayla vehaya keetz shatul al palge mayim asher piryo yitten beitto vealehu lo yibbol vechol asher yaase yatzliach".

Machriz rabbi alekkesanderi: man bae chayye? man bae chayye? (kanevaf) [ikkenuf] vaato kulle alma legabbeh, amri leh: hav lan chayye! amar lehu: "mi haish hechafetz chayyim vegomer netzor leshoncha mera vegomer".

"Sur mera vaase tov vegomer", shemma yomar: natzarti leshoni mera usefatay middabber mirma, elech veetgare beshena? talmud lomar: "sur mera vaase tov", veen "tov" ella tora, shenneemar: "ki lekach tov natatti lachem torati al taazovu".

Higgia lakkippa makom shemmaamidin bah avoda zara. amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi yochanan: im bana — secharo muttar. peshita! meshammeshe avoda zara hen, umeshammeshe avoda zara, ben lerabbi yishmael ben lerabbi akiva, enan asurin ad shibedu.

Amar rabbi yirmeya: lo nitzrecha ella laavoda zara atzmah. hanicha leman deamar: avoda zara shel yisrael asura miyyad, veshel goy ad shetteaved — shappir, ella leman deamar: shel goy asura miyyad, may ikka lememar?
Ella amar rabba bar ulla: lo nitzrecha ella bemakkosh acharon. avoda zara man ka garem la? gemar melacha, veemat havya gemar melacha? bemakkosh acharon. makkosh acharon let beh shave peruta.
Alma kasavar, yeshnah lischirut mittechilla vead sof.

Mishna veen osin tachshitin laavoda zara, katlaot unezamim vetabbaot. rabbi eliezer omer: besachar muttar. en mochrin lahem bimchubbar lakkarka, aval mocher hu mishsheyyikkatzetz. rabbi yehuda omer: mocher hu al menat lakotz.
Gemara menahane mille? amar rabbi yose bar chanina:

a: Deamar kera: "lo techonnem", lo titten lahem chanayay bakkarka. hay "la techonnem" mibbee leh, dehachi kaamar rachamana: lo titten lahem chen.
Im ken, lema kera "lo techunnem", may "lo techonnem"? shema minna tarte.
Veakkatti mibbee leh, dehachi amar rachamana: lo titten lahem mattenat (shel) chinnam! im ken, lema kera "lo techinnem", may "lo techonnem"? shema minna kullehu.
Tanya name hachi: "lo techonnem" — lo titten lahem chanayay bakkarka, davar acher: "lo techonnem" — lo titten lahem chen, davar acher: "lo techonnem" — lo titten lahem mattenat chinnam.

Umattenat chinnam gufa tannae hi, detanya: "lo tochlu kol nevela lagger asher bisharecha tittenenna vaachalah o machor lenochri", en li ella leger bintina ulegoy bimchira, leger bimchira minnayin? talmud lomar: "tittenenna... o machor".

Legoy bintina minnayin? talmud lomar: "tittenenna vaachalah o machor lenochri", nimtza atta omer: echad ger veechad goy ben bintina ben bimchira, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: devarim kichtavan, leger bintina, ulegoy bimchira.
Shappir kaamar rabbi meir, verabbi yehuda amar lach: i salka datach kidkaamar rabbi meir, lichtov rachamana "tittenenna vaachalah vmachor", "o" lema li? shema minna lidvarim kichtavan hu daata.
Verabbi meir? hahu leakdome netina deger limchira degoy. verabbi yehuda: kevan deger atta metzvvev lehacheyoto, vegoy i atta metzvvev lehachayoto — lehakedim la tzerich kera.
Davar acher: "lo techonnem" — lo titten lahem chen. mesayyay leh lerav, deamar rav: asur laadam sheyyomar "kamma naa goya zo".

Metivi: maase berabban shimon ben gamliel shehaya al gabbe maala behar habbayit, veraa goya achat naa beyoter, amar: "ma rabbu maasecha Adonai". veaf rabbi akiva raa eshet toranuserufus harasha, rak, sachak uvacha. rak — shehayta baa mittippa serucha, sachak — daatida demiggayyra venasev la, bacha — dehay shufera bale afra.
Verav, odoye hu deka mode, deamar mar: haroe beriyyot tovot omer "baruch shekkacha bara beolamo".
Uleistakkole mi shere? metivi: "venishmarta mikkol davar ra" — shello yistakkel adam beishsha naa vaafillu penuya, beeshet ish vaafillu mechoeret,
b: Velo bevigde tzeva [shel] ishsha, velo bachamor velo bachamora, velo bachazir velo bachazira, velo beofot bizman shennizkakin ze laze, vaafillu male enayim kemalach hammavet.

Amru alav al malach hammavet, shekkullo male enayim, bishat petirato shel chole omed meal meraashotav, vecharbo shelufa beyado, vetippa shel mara teluya bo, kevan shechole roe oto mizdazea ufoteach piv, vezorkah letoch piv, mimmenna met, mimmenna masriach, mimmenna panav morikot!
Keren zavit havay.

Velo bevigde tzeva [shel] ishsha. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: afillu shetuchin al gabbe kotel. amar rav pappa: uvemakkir baalehen. amar rava: dayka name, dekatane "velo bevigde tzeva ishsha", vela katane "velo bevigde tzivonin", shema minna.
Amar rav chisda: hane mille beattike, aval bechadte let lan ba, dei la tema hachi, anan mana leashpore hechi yahavinan? ha ka mistakkel!
Uletamaych, ha deamar rav yehuda: min bemino muttar lehachenis kemichchol bishfoferet, ha ka mistakkal! ella baavidteh terid, hachi name baavidteh terid.

Amar mar: mimmenna met. nema peliga daavu dishmuel, deamar avu dishmuel: amar li malach hammavet "i la dechayeshna likara divriyyayta, hava parana bet hashshechita kivhema". dilma hahi tippa mechattecha lehu lesimanin.
Mimmenna masriach. mesayyay leh lerabbi chanina bar kahana, deamar rabbi chanina bar kahana: amri be rav: harotze shello yasriach meto, yehappechennu al panav.
Tanu rabbanan: "venishmarta mikkol davar ra", shello yeharher adam bayyom veyavo lide tumea ballayla.

Mikkan amar rabbi pinchas ben yair: tora mevia lide zehirut, zehirut mevia lide zerizut, zerizut mevia lide nekiyyut, nekiyyut mevia lide perishut, perishut mevia lide tohora, tohora mevia lide chasidut, chasidut mevia lide anava, anava mevia lide yirat chet, yirat chet mevia lide kedushsha, kedushsha mevia lide ruach hakkodesh, ruach hakkodesh mevia lide techiyyayt hammetim, vachasidut gedola mikkullan, shenneemar: "az dibbarta vechazon lachasidecha".

Ufeliga derabbi yehoshua ben levi, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: anava gedola mikkullan, shenneemar: "ruach Adonai elohim alay yaan mashach Adonai oti levasser anavim", "chasidim" lo neemar ella "anavim", ha lamadta sheanava gedola mikkullan.

En mochrin lahen vechulei. tanu rabbanan: mochrin lahen ilan al menat lakotz vekotzetz, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer: en mochrin lahen ella ketzutza. shachat al menat ligzoz vegozez, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer: en mochrin lahen ella gezuza. kama al menat liktzor vekotzer, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer: en mochrin ella ketzura.
Utzericha, dei ashmeinan ilan, beha kaamar rabbi meir, kevan dela pased meshahe leh, aval hay dechi meshahe le pased, ema mode leh lerabbi yehuda.
Vei ashmeinan behane tarte, mishshum dela yedia shevachayyhu, aval shachat didia shevachayyhu — ema mode leh lerabbi meir.
Vei ashmeinan beha, beha kaamar rabbi meir, aval behanach ema mode leh lerabbi yehuda, tzericha.
Ibbaya lehu: behema al menat lishchot, mahu?
Hatam tama may share rabbi yehuda? delav birshuteh kayymi vela matze meshahe lehu, aval behema, kevan devirshuteh degoy kayyma, meshahe lah, o dilma la shena?
Ta shema, detanya: behema al menat lishchot veshochet, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer: en mochrin lo ella shechuta.
Mishna en maskirin lahem battim beeretz yisrael, veen tzarich lomar sadot, uvesureya

a: Maskirin lahem battim aval lo sadot, uvechutza laaretz mochrin lahem battim umaskirin sadot, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer: beeretz yisrael maskirin lahem battim aval lo sadot, uvesureya mochrin battim umaskirin sadot, uvechutza laaretz mochrin ellu vaellu.

Af bemakom sheamru lehasekir, lo levet dira amru, mippene shehu machnis letocho avoda zara, shenneemar: "lo tavi toeva el betecha", uvechol makom lo yaskir lo et hammerchatz, mippene shehu nikra al shemo.
Gemara may "en tzarich lomar sadot"? illema mishshum deit ba tarte: chada, chanayayt karka; vachada, deka mafka la mimmaaser.
I hachi, battim name ikka tarte: chada, chanayayt karka; vachada, deka mafka la mimmezuza! amar rav mesharsheya: mezuza chovat haddar hu.
Besureya maskirin battim kulei. may shena mechira dela? mishshum mechira deeretz yisrael. i hachi, missechirut name nigzor! hi gufa gezera, vaanan nekum venigzor gezera ligzera?
Veha sechirut sade divsureya, digzera ligzera hi, veka gazrinan! hatam lav gezera hu, kasavar: kibbush yachid shemeh kibbush.
Sade deit beh tarte — gezaru beh rabbanan, battim delet behu tarte — la gezaru behu rabbanan.
Bechutza laaretz vechulei. sade deit beh tarte — gezaru behu rabbanan, battim delet behu tarte — la gezaru behu rabbanan.
Rabbi yose omer: beeretz yisrael maskirin lahem battim vechulei. may tama? sadot deit behu tarte — gezaru behu rabbanan, battim delet behu tarte — la gezaru behu rabbanan.
Uvesureya mochrin vechulei. may tama? kasavar: kibbush yachid la shemeh kibbush, vesade deit ba tarte — gezaru ba rabbanan, battim delet behu tarte — la gezaru behu rabbanan.
Uvechutza laaretz mochrin vechulei. may tama? kevan dimrachak, la gazrinan.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yose. amar rav yosef: uvilvad shello yaasenna shechuna. vechamma shechuna? tana: en shechuna pechuta mishshelosha bene adam.
Velechush dilma azel hay yisrael umezabben lechad goy, veazel haych umezabben la litre! amar abbaye: allifne" mippakkedinan, allifne" delifne" la mippakkedinan.
Af bemakom sheamru lehasekir. mikkelal deikka ducheta dela mogri.
b: Usetama kerabbi meir, dei rabbi yose, bechol ducheta mogri.
Uvechol makom lo yiskor vechulei. tanya: rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: lo yiskor adam merchatzo legoy, mippene shennikra al shemo, vegoy ze ose bo melacha beshabbatot uveyamim tovim.
Aval lechuti, may? shere. kuti emar aved beh melacha bechullo shel moed! bechullo shel moed anan name avdinan.
Aval sadehu legoy, may? shere. may tama? arisa arisuteh kaaved. merchatz name amri: arisa arisuteh kaaved? arisa demerchatz la avdi anshe.

Tanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: lo yaskir adam sadehu lechuti, mippene shennikret al shemo, vechuti ze ose bo melacha bechullo shel moed. aval goy may? shere, deamri: arisa arisuteh aved. i hachi, kuti name amri: arisa arisuteh aved!

a: Arisuta lerabbi shimon ben elazar let leh, ella goy may tama muttar? deamrinan leh vetzayet. kuti name amrinan leh vetzayet! kuti la tzayet, deamar: ana gemirna tefe minnach.
I hachi, may irya mippene shennikret al shemo? tippok leh mishshum "lifne ivver lo titten michshol"! chada veod kaamar: chada — mishshum "lifne ivver", veod — mippene shennikret al shemo.
Hanhu morikae degoy naket beshabbeta, veyisrael bechad beshabbeta, ato lekammeh derava — shera lehu.
Etiveh ravina lerava: yisrael vegoy shekkibbelu sade beshuttafut, lo yomar yisrael legoy: "tol chelkecha bashshabbat vaani bachol", veim hitnu mittechilla — muttar,
Veim bau lecheshbon — asur. ikkesif, lesof iggallay milleta dehitnu meikkara havo.
Rav geviha mibbe chetil amar: hanhu shetile deorla, hava goy achel shene deorla, veyisrael shene dehettera. ato lekammeh derava, shera lehu.
Veha otveh ravina lerava! lesayyoe sayyeyeh. veha ikkesif! lo hayu devarim meolam.
Ibbaya lehu: setama may? ta shema: im hitnu mittechilla — muttar, ha setama — asur.
Ema sefa: im bau lecheshbon — asur, ha setama — muttar! ella, meha lekka lemishma minna.
Hadaran alach lifne edehen.

Mishna en maamidin behema befunedkaot shel goyim, mippene shechashudin al harvia, velo tityayched ishsha immahen, mippene shechashudin al haarayot, velo yityayched adam immahen, mippene shechashudin al shefichut damim.
b: Gemara ureminhi: lokchin mehen behema lekorban, veen choshshin lo mishshum rovea, velo mishshum nirba, velo mishshum muketze, velo mishshum neevad.

Bishlama muketze veneevad, im ita deaktzeyeh veim ita defalcheh — la hava mezabben leh, ella rovea venirba lechush! amar rav tachlifa amar rav shela bar avina mishshemeh derav: goy chas al behemto shello teaker.
Hatinach nekevot, zecharim may ikka lememar? amar rav kahana: hoil umachchishin babbasar.
Ella ha detanya: lokchin behema meroe shellahen, lechush dilma rava lah! roe shellahen mityayre mishshum hefsed sachar.
Ella ha detanya: en mosrin behema laroe shellahen, lema: roe shellahen mityayre mishshum hefsed secharo!
Inhu deyadi bahadade, miratti. anan dela yadinan behu, la miratti. amar rabba: hayeynu deamri inashe: machteva gelala baza, raggala bechavreh yada.
I hachi, zecharim minnekevot la nizbon, dechayyshinan dilma marbea leh illava! kevan demiggare ba, miratta.
Ella ha detane rav yosef: armalta la terabbe kalba, vela tashre bar be rav beushepiza. bishlama bar be rav tzenia la, ella kalba, kevan demiggare ba — miratta!
Kevan dechi shadya leh umetza umisserich abbatra, memar amri inashe: hay demisserich abbatra mishshum umetza deka misserich.
Nekevot etzel nekevot, may tama la meyaychadinan? amar mar ukeva bar chama: mippene shehaggoyim metzuyin etzel neshe chavrehen, ufeamim sheeno motzah umotze et habbehema verovah.

Veibbaet ema: afillu motzah name rovah, deamar mar: chaviva alehen behemtan shel yisrael yoter minneshotehen, deamar rabbi yochanan: beshaa shebba nachash al chavva hetil bah zuhama. i hachi, yisrael name? yisrael sheamdu al har sinay — paska zuhamatan, goyim shello amdu al har sinay — lo paska zuhamatan.

Ibbaya lehu: ofot may? ta shema, deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel mishshum rabbi chanina: ani raiti goy shellakach avvavz min hashshuk, revaah, chanakah, tzelaah, vaachalah. veamar rabbi yirmeya middifti: ani raiti arvi echad shellakach yarech min hashshuk, vechakak bah kede revia, revaah, tzelaah, vaachalah.

a: Ravina amar: la kashya — ha lechattechilla, ha diavad.

Umena temra deshane ben lechattechilla ben lediavad? ditnan: lo tityayched ishsha immahem, mippene shechashudin al haarayot. ureminhu: haishsha shennechbesha bide goyim, al yede mamon — mutteret levalah, al yede nefashot — asura levalah!
Ella lav shema minna, shane lan ben lechattechilla lediavad? mimmay? dilma leolam ema lach: afillu diavad name la, vehacha hayeynu tama, demityayre mishshum hefsed mamono.
Teda, dekatane sefa: al yede nefashot asura levalah, vetu la middi.

Rabbi pedat amar: la kashya — ha rabbi eliezer, ha rabbanan. ditnan gabbe parat chattat: rabbi eliezer omer: enah nikkachat min haggoyim, vachachamim mattirin. may lav beha kamippalgi, derabbi eliezer savar: chayyshinan lirvia, verabbanan savri: la chayyshinan lirvia?

Mimmay? dilma dechulle alma la chayyshinan lirvia, vehacha hayeynu tama derabbi eliezer — kidrav yehuda amar rav, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: hinniach (alehen) [aleha] udda shel sakkin — pesalah, uveegla — ad shettimshoch bah.
Mar savar chayyshinan, umar savar la chayyshinan! la salka datach, mishshum nicha pureta la mafsed tuva.
Hachi name lema: mishshum hanaa pureta la mafsed tuva! hatam, yitzro tokfo.

Vedilma dechulle alma la chayyshinan lirvia, vehacha hayeynu tama derabbi eliezer, kidtane shela, detane shela: may tama derabbi eliezer? "dabber el bene yisrael veyikchu elecha" — bene yisrael yikchu, veen haggoyim yikchu.

La salka datach, dekatane sefa: vechen haya rabbi eliezer posel bechol hakkarbanot kullan. vei salka datach kidtane shela, bishlama para — ketiv bah "kicha", ella kullehu korbanot — kicha ketiv behu? vedilma ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi eliezer.
b: Ella befara, dedameha yekarin, aval bishar korbenot modu leh!
Veella ha detanya: lokchin mehen behema lekorban, manni? la rabbi eliezer vela rabbanan!
Veod, tanya behedya: may otivu leh chavrohi lerabbi eliezer? "kol tzon kedar yikkavtzu lach... yaalu leratzon al mizbechi".
Ad kan la peligi ella bachashasha, aval hecha devadday rava — pasla; shema minna defara kodshe mizbeach hi, dei kodshe bedek habbayit — mi mayfsela ba revia?!
Shane para, dechattat karyay rachamana.
Ella meatta, tippasel beyotze dofen! vechi tema hachi name, allema tanya: hikdishah beyotze dofen — pesula, verabbi shimon machshir?
Vechi tema, rabbi shimon letameh, deamar: yotze dofen valad mealleya hu, vehaamar rabbi yochanan: mode haya rabbi shimon leinyan kadashim sheeno kadosh!

Ella shane para, hoil umum posel bah — devar erva vaavoda zara name posel bah, dichtiv: "ki moshchatam bahem mum bam", vetana deve rabbi yishmael: kol makom shenneemar hashechata — eno ella devar erva vaavoda zara.
Devar erva, dichtiv: "ki hishchit kol basar et darko al haaretz", vaavoda zara, dichtiv: "pen tashchitun vaasitem lachem pesel"; veha para name, hoil umum posel bah, devar erva vaavoda zara pasli ba.

Gufa, tane shela: may tama derabbi eliezer? dichtiv: "dabber el bene yisrael veyikchu", bene yisrael yikchu, veen haggoyim yikchu. ella meatta: "dabber el bene yisrael veyikchu li teruma", hachi name divne yisrael yikchu, veen haggoyim yikchu?

Vechi tema: hachi name, vehaamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shaalu et rabbi eliezer: ad hechan kibbud av vaem? amar lahem: tzeu ureu ma asa goy echad leaviv beashkelon, vedama ben netina shemo. paam achat bikkeshu mimmennu avanim laefod

a: Beshishshim ribbo sachar, rav kahana matne bishmonim ribbo, vehayu maftechot munnachot tachat meraashotav shel aviv, velo tzaaro.
"Avne shoham" hifsik hainyan, veha "veavne milluim" ketiv, dahadar arveh!

Veod, katane sefa: leshana acheret nolda lo para adumma beedro, nichnesu chachme yisrael etzlo. amar lahem: yodea ani bachem sheim ani mevakkesh mikkem kol mamon shebbaolam attem notnin li, achshav eni mevakkesh mikkem ella oto mamon shehifsadti bishvil abba.
Hatam, al yede taggare yisrael zevun.
Verabbi eliezer la chayesh lirvia?

Vehatanya, amru lo lerabbi eliezer: maase ulekachuha min haggoy, vedama shemo, veamri la remetz shemo. amar lahen rabbi eliezer: mishsham reaya? yisrael hayu meshammerin otah mishshaa shennolda! rabbi eliezer tarte it leh: kicha, vechayesh name lirvia.

Amar mar: yisrael hayu meshammerin otah mishshaa shennolda. venechush dilma ravi leimma ki hava meabbera! deamar rava: vevlad hannogachat asura — hi uveladah nagchu, vevlad hannirbaat asura — hi uveladah nirbeu. ema: yisrael hayu meshammerin otah mishshaa shennotzra.
Venechush dilma ravuha leimma meikkara! ditnan: kol happesulin legabbe mizbeach — valdotehen muttarin, vetane ala: rabbi eliezer oser.
Hanicha lerava, deamar rava amar rav nachman: machloket keshennirbeu keshehen mukedashin, aval keshehen chullin — divre hakkol muttarin.
Ella lerav huna bar chinnana amar rav nachman: machloket keshennirbeu keshehen chullin, aval keshehen mukedashin — divre hakkol asurin, may ikka lememar?
Ema: yisrael hayu meshammerin otah leimmah mishshaa shennotzra. venechush dilma ravuha leimma deimma! kulle hay la chayyshinan.
Amar mar: yisrael hayu meshammerin otah mishshaa shennotzra. mena yadinan? amar rav kahana: kos adom maavirin lefaneha beshaa sheole aleha zachar.
I hachi, ammay dameha yekarin? hoil ushete searot poslot bah. umay shena didhu? amar rav kahana: bemuchezeket.
Yatev rabbi amme verabbi yitzchak nappacha akkila derabbi yitzchak nappacha, petach chad minnayyhu vaamar: vechen haya rabbi eliezer posel bechol hakkarbanot kullan.
Petach iddach minnayyhu veamar: may otivu leh chavrohi lerabbi eliezer? "kol tzon kedar yikkavtzu lach vegomer"! amar lahen rabbi eliezer: kullam gerim gerurim hem leatid lavo.
Amar rav yosef: may kera? "ki az ehpoch el ammim safa verura vegomer". amar leh abbaye: vedilma meavoda zara hu dahadur behu? amar leh rav yosef: "leovdo shechem echad" ketiv.

Rav pappa matne hachi, verav zevid matne hachi, vetarvayyhu amri: vechen haya rabbi eliezer posel bechol hakkarbanot, vetarvayyhu amri: umay otivu leh chavrohi lerabbi eliezer? "kol tzon kedar yikkavtzu lach vegomer", amar rabbi eliezer: kullam gerim gerurim hem leatid lavo.
Umay keraa? "ki az ehpoch el ammim safa verura likro chullam beshem Adonai". matkef la rav yosef: vedilma meavoda zara hu dehadri behu? amar leh abbaye: "leovdo shechem echad" ketiv.
Metivi: "vayyomer moshe gam atta titten beyadenu zevachim veolot"! kodem mattan tora shane.
Ta shema: "vayyikkach yitro choten moshe ola uzevachim lelohim"! yitro name kodem mattan tora hava. hanicha leman deamar: yitro kodem mattan tora hava, ella leman deamar:
b: Yitro leachar mattan tora hava, may ikka lememar? ella, yitro miyyisrael zevan.
Ta shema: "vayyomer shaul meamaleki hevium asher chamal haam al metav hatztzon vehabbakar (hammishnim vehakkarim veal kol hatztzon) lemaan zevoach laAdonai elohecha"! may "metav"? deme metav.
Umay shena metav? ki hechi delikpotz alayhu zavoyna.
Ta shema: "vayyomer aravna el david yikkach veyaal adoni hammelech (et) hattov beeno (veet) [ree] habbakar laola vehammoriggim uchele habbakar laetzim"! amar rav nachman: aravna ger toshav haya.

May moriggim? amar ulla: mitta shel turebil. may mitta shel turebil? izza dekureksa dedayyshan. amar rav yosef: may kera? "hinne samtich lemorag charutz chadash baal pifiyyot tadush harim vetadok ugevaot kammotz tasim".
Metivi: "veet happarot heelu ola laAdonai"! horaat shaa hayta.
Hachi name mistabbera, dei la tema hachi, ola nekeva mi ikka?

Umay kusheya? dilma bevamat yachid, vechidrav adda bar ahava, deamar rav adda bar ahava: minnayin leola nekeva shehi keshera bevamat yachid? shenneemar: "vayyikkach shemuel tele chalav echad vayyaalehu ola".
"Vayyaalehu" — zachar mashma! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: "vayyaaleha" ketiv.
Rabbi yochanan amar: gevul yesh lah, pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim — neekeret, bat shalosh shanim — enah neekeret.
Etiveh kol hane teyuvata, shanni lehu: pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim. ta shema: "veet happarot heelu ola laAdonai" — bifchuta mibbat shalosh shanim.
Matkef la rav huna bereh derav natan: im ken, hayeynu "veet benehem kalu vabbayit" — pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim?
Ufechuta mibbat shalosh shanim mi ka yalda? vehatanya: para vachamor mibbat shalosh — vadday lakkohen, mikkan veelach — safek. ella mechavvavrta kidshannin meikkara.

"Vayyishsharna happarot badderech al derech bet shemesh vegomer", may "vayyishsharna"? amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi meir: sheamru shira. verav zutera bar toviyya amar rav: sheyyishsheru penehem keneged aron veamru shira.
Umay shira amru? amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi meir: "az yashir moshe uvene yisrael", verabbi yochanan dideh amar: "vaamartem bayyom hahu hodu laAdonai kiru vishmo vegomer".
Verabbi shimon ben lakish amar: mizmora yatma, "mizmor shiru laAdonai shir chadash ki niflaot asa hoshia lo yemino uzeroa kodsho". rabbi elazar amar: "Adonai malach yirgezu ammim".

Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: "Adonai malach geut lavesh". rabbi yitzchak nappacha amar: "ronni ronni hashshita, hitnoffi berov hadarech, hamechushsheket berikme zahav, hamehullala bidvir armon, umefoara baadi adayim".
Rav ashe matne la leha derabbi yitzchak, aha "vayhi binsoa haaron vayyomer moshe kuma Adonai", yisrael may amru? amar rabbi yitzchak: "ronni ronni hashshita" vechulei.
Amar rav: keman karu parsae lesafra "devir"? mehacha, "veshem devir lefanim kiryat sefer".
Rav ashe amar: keman karu parsae lenidda "dashtana"? mehacha, "ki derech nashim li".

a: "Vayyiddom hashshemesh veyareach amad ad yikkom goy oyvav halo hi chetuva al sefer hayyashar", may sefer hayyashar? amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: ze sefer avraham yitzchak veyaakov, shennikreu yesharim, shenneemar: "tamot nafshi mot yesharim".
