Vehecha remiza? "vezaro yihye melo haggoyim", [ematay yihye melo haggoyim?] beshaa sheamda lo chamma lihoshua, "vayyaamod hashshemesh bachatzi hashshamayim velo atz lavo keyom tamim".
Vechamma? amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: esrim vearba [shae], azal shet vekam shet, azal shet vekam shet, kulla milleta keyom tamim.

Rabbi elazar amar: sheloshim veshet, azal shet vekam teresar, azal shet vekam teresar, amidato keyom tamim. rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: arbaim ushemona, azal shet vekam teresar, azal shet vekam esrim vearbea, [shenneemar]: "velo atz lavo keyom tamim", mikkelal demeikkara lav keyom tamim [hava].

Ikka deamri, betosefta peligi: rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: esrim vearbea — azal shet vekam teresar, azal shet vekam teresar, amidato keyom tamim. rabbi elazar amar: sheloshim vashesh — azal shet vekam teresar, azal shet vekam esrim vearbea, "velo atz lavo keyom tamim".
Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: arbaim ushemona, azal shet vekam esrim vearbea, azal shet vekam esrim vearbea, makkish amidato leviato — ma biato keyom tamim, af amidato keyom tamim.

Tana: keshem sheamda lo chamma lihoshua, kach amda lo chamma lemoshe ulenakdimon ben gureyon. yehoshua — kerae, nakdimon ben gureyon — gemara. lemoshe menalan? atya "achel" "achel": ketiv hacha "achel tet pachdecha", uchetiv hatam bihoshua "achel gaddelcha".
Verabbi yochanan amar, atya "tet" "tet": ketiv hacha "achel tet pachdecha", uchetiv bihoshua "beyom tet Adonai et haemori".
Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar, miggufeh dikra shamat leh: "asher yishmeun shimacha veragzu vechalu mippanecha", ematay "ragzu vechalu mippanecha"? beshaa sheamda lo chamma lemoshe.

Metivi: "velo haya kayyom hahu lefanav veacharav"! ibbaet ema: shaot hu dela havo (nafish) [nefishan] kulle hay, veibbaet ema: avne varad la havo, dichtiv: "vayhi benusam mippene bene yisrael hem bemorad bet choron vaAdonai hishlich alehem avanim gedolot min hashshamayim ad azeka vayyamutu".

Ketiv "vayyomer lelammed bene yehuda kashet hinne chetuva al sefer hayyashar", may "sefer hayyashar"? amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: ze sefer avraham yitzchak veyaakov, shennikreu "yesharim", dichtiv behu "tamot nafshi mot yesharim utehi achariti kamohu".
Vehecha remiza? "yehuda atta yoducha achecha yadcha beoref oyvecha", veezo hi milchama shetztzericha yad keneged oref? heve omer: zo keshet.

Rabbi elazar omer: ze sefer mishne tora, veammay karu leh "sefer hayyashar"? dichtiv: "veasita hayyashar vehattov beene Adonai". vehecha remiza? "yadav rav lo", veezo hi milchama shetztzericha shete yadayim? heve omer: zo keshet.

Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: ze sefer shoftim, veammay karu leh "sefer hayyashar"? dichtiv: "bayyamim hahem en melech beyisrael ish hayyashar beenav yaase", vehecha remiza? "lemaan daat dorot bene yisrael lelammedam milchama", veezo hi milchama shetztzericha limmud? heve omer: zo keshet.
Umenalan devihuda ketiv? dichtiv: "mi yaale lanu vattechilla el hakkenaani lehillachem bo, vayyomer Adonai yehuda yaale".
"Vayyarem hattabbach et hashshok vehealeha vayyasem lifne shaul", may "vehealeha"? rabbi yochanan omer: shok vealya. may "vehealeha"? dimsammecha shok lealya.

Verabbi elazar omer: shok vechaze, may "vehealeha"? demachet le lechaze illaveh deshok ki vae onofe, umonfi leh. verabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: shok veshofi, may "vehealeha"? shofi illaveh deshok kae.
Lo tityayched ishsha immahem, bemay askinan? ilema bechad, dichvavta gabbe yisrael mi shere? vehatnan: "lo yityayched ish echad im shete nashim"!
b: Ella bitlata. dichvavta gabbe yisrael, bifrutzim mi shere? vehatnan: "aval ishsha achat mityaychedet im shene anashim", veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo shanu ella bichsherim, aval bifrutzim afillu asara name la. maase haya vehotziuha asara bemitta!
La, tzericha beishto immo. goy en ishto meshammarto, aval yisrael ishto meshammarto.
Vetippok leh mishshum shefichut damim! amar rabbi yirmeya: beishsha chashuva askinan, demiratti minna. rav idi amar: ishsha kele zayynah aleha.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu: ishsha chashuva ben anashim, vesheenah chashuva ben hannashim.
Tanya kevavteh derav idi bar avin: haishsha, af al pi shehashshalom immah, lo tityayched immahen, mippene shechashudin al haarayot.

Lo yityayched adam immahen. tanu rabbanan: yisrael shennizdammen lo goy badderech — toflo limino. rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: besayif — toflo limino, bemakkel — toflo lismolo.
Hayu olin bemaale o yordin birida, lo yehe yisrael lematta vegoy lemala, ella yisrael lemala vegoy lematta, veal yashuach lefanav, shemma yarotz et gulegolto.
Shealo lehechan holech — yarchiv lo et hadderech, kederech sheasa yaakov avinu leesav harasha, dichtiv: "ad asher avo el adoni seira",
Uchetiv: "veyaakov nasa sukkota".

Maase betalmide rabbi akiva shehayu holchim lichziv, pagu bahen listim, amru lahen: lean attem holchim? amru lahen: leakko. kevan shehiggiu lichziv, pershu. amru lahen: talmide mi attem? amru lahen: talmide rabbi akiva. amru lahen: ashre rabbi akiva vetalmidav shello paga bahen adam ra meolam.
Rav menashshe hava azel

a: Leve torta, pegau beh gannave, amaru leh: lean kaazlat? amar lahen: lefumebdita. ki meta leve torta, paresh. amaru leh: talmida dihuda rammaa at! amar lehu: yaditu leh? yehe raava delihvo hanhu inashe beshamteh.

Azalu avadu genevata esrin vetarten shenin vela atzlachu, kevan dachazo, ato kullehu tevau shamtayyhu, vahava behu chad girdena dela ata lesharoye shammeteh, achleh arya. hayeynu deamri inashe: girdana dela tayyzan, shatta (batzir mishshene) [betzira mishsheneh].
Ta chazi, ma ben gannave vavel velistin deeretz yisrael.

Mishna bat yisrael lo teyaylled et hannochrit, mippene shemmeyalledet ben laavoda zara, aval nochrit meyalledet bat yisrael. bat yisrael lo tanik benah shel nochrit, aval nochrit menika benah shel yisrael birshutah.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: bat yisrael lo teyaylled et hannochrit, mippene shemmeyalledet ben laavoda zara, venochrit lo teyaylled et bat yisrael, mippene shechashudin al shefichut damim — divre rabbi meir.

Vachachamim omrim: nochrit meyalledet et bat yisrael bizman sheacherot omdot al gabbah, aval lo benah levenah. verabbi meir omer: afillu acherot omdot al gabbah name la, dezimnin demannecha leh yeda appute vekatla leh, vela mitchaze.
Ki hahi itteta daamara lachaverta: molda yehudayyayta bat molda yehudayyayta! amara la: nefishin bishata dehahi itteta, deka mashpelna minnayyhu dema ki ufeya denahara.
Verabbanan amaru lach: la hi, bemilleta bealma hu deokemta.

Bat yisrael lo tanik. tanu rabbanan: bat yisrael lo tanik benah shel nochrit, mippene shemmegaddelet ben laavoda zara, venochrit lo tanik et benah shel bat yisrael, mippene shechashuda al shefichut damim, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: nochrit menika et benah shel bat yisrael bizman sheacherot omdot al gabbah, aval lo beno levenah. verabbi meir omer: afillu acherot omdot al gabbah name la, dezimnin deshayyfa leh samma ledad meabbaray vekatla leh.

Utzericha, dei ashmeinan meyalledet, behahi kaamri rabbanan dishre, dela efshar mishshum daacherot root otah, aval menika deefshar deshayyfa leh sam ledad meabbaray vekatla leh — ema mode leh lerabbi meir.

Vei ashmeinan menika, behahi kaamar rabbi meir deasur, mishshum deshayyfa leh sam ledad meabbaray vekatla leh, aval meyalledet, dela efshar hecha daacherot omdot al gabbah, ema mode lehu lerabbanan — tzericha.
Ureminhu: yehudit meyalledet arammit besachar, aval lo bechinnam! amar rav yosef: besachar shere mishshum eva.

Savar rav yosef lememar: olode nochrit beshabbeta besachar shere, mishshum eva. amar leh abbaye: yachla lememar la — didan, dimynatteri shabbeta — mechallelinan alayyhu; didchu, dela meynatteri shabbeta — la mechallelinan.
Savar rav yosef lememar: onoke besachar shere mishshum eva. amar leh abbaye: yachla lememar, i penuya hi — "baena leinnesove", i eshet ish hi — "la ka mizdahamna beappe gavray".
Savar rav yosef lememar, ha detanya: haggoyim veroe behema dakka lo maalin velo moridin — assoke besachar shere, mishshum eva.
Amar leh abbaye: yachol lomar lo "kae beri aiggara", i name "nekita li zimna leve davvar".
Tane rabbi avahu kammeh derabbi yochanan: haggoyim veroe behema dakka — lo maalin
b: Velo moridin, aval hamminin vehammasorot vehameshummadim — moridin velo maalin.
Amar leh: ani shone "lechol avedat achicha" lerabbot et hameshummad, veat amrat moridin? semi mikkan meshummad!
Velishanne leh: kan bimshummad ochel nevelot leteavon, kan bimshummad ochel nevelot lehacheis! kasavar: ochel nevelot lehacheis — min hu.
Ittemar meshummad, peligi rav acha veravina: chad amar: leteavon — meshummad, lehacheis — min have, vechad amar: afillu lehacheis name meshummad. ella ezehu min? ze haoved avoda zara.
Metivi: achal parosh echad o yattush echad — hare ze meshummad; veha hacha dilhachis hu, vekatane meshummad! hatam bae lemitam tama deissura.

Amar mar: moridin aval lo maalin. hasheta achote machatinan, assoke mibbee? amar rav yosef bar chama amar rav sheshet: lo nitzrecha, sheim hayta maala babbor — megarrah, denaket leh illa veamar: la techot chevta illaveh.

Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: lo nitzrecha, sheim hayta even al pi habbeer, mechassah, amar: leabbore chayyuta illavay. ravina amar: sheim haya sullam, mesalleko, amar: baena leachote beri meiggara.
Tanu rabbanan: yisrael mal et haggoy leshum ger, leappoke leshum murena dela, vegoy lo yamul yisrael, mippene shechashudin al shefichut damim, divre rabbi meir.

Vachachamim omrim: goy mal et yisrael bizman sheacherim omdin al gabbo, aval beno leveno — la. verabbi meir omer: afillu acherim omdim al gabbo name la, dezimnin dematzle leh sakkina umeshavve leh kerut shofcha.
Vesavar rabbi meir goy la? ureminhu: ir sheen bah rofe yisrael veyesh bah rofe kuti verofe armay — yamul armay veal yamul kuti, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: yamul kuti veal yamul armay!
Efoch, rabbi meir omer: yamul kuti velo armay, rabbi yehuda omer: armay velo kuti.
Vesavar rabbi yehuda armay shappir dame? vehatanya: rabbi yehuda omer: minnayin lemila begoy shehi pesula? shenneemar: "veatta et beriti tishmor".
Ella, leolam la tefoch, vehacha bemay askinan?

a: Berofe mumeche, dechi ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan: im haya mumeche lerabbim — muttar.
Vesavar rabbi yehuda kuti shappir dame? vehatanya: yisrael mal et hakkuti, vechuti lo yamul yisrael, mippene shemmal leshem har gerizim, divre rabbi yehuda.
Amar lo rabbi yose: vechi hechan matzinu mila min hattora lishmah? ella mal veholech ad shettetze nishmato!
Ella, leolam efoch kidafchinan meikkara, udeka kashya derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda — hahi derabbi yehuda hannasi hi.
Detanya, rabbi yehuda hannasi omer: minnayin lemila begoy shehi pesula? talmud lomar: "veatta et beriti tishmor".
Amar rav chisda: may tama derabbi yehuda? dichtiv: "laAdonai himmol", verabbi yose — "himmol yimmol".
Veiddach, hachtiv: "laAdonai himmol"! hahu befesach ketiv. veiddach name hachtiv: "himmol yimmol"! dibbera tora chilshon bene adam.
Ittemar: minnayin lemila begoy shehi pesula? daru bar pappa mishshemeh derav amar: "veatta et beriti tishmor", verabbi yochanan: "himmol yimmol".
May benayyhu? arvi mahul vegavnuni mahul ikka benayyhu. man deamar "himmol yimmol" — ikka, uman deamar "et beriti tishmor" — lekka.
Uleman deamar "himmol yimmol" ikka? vehatnan: kunnam sheani nehene min haarelim — muttar bearle yisrael, veasur bemule ummot haolam; alma, af al gav dimhili, keman dela mehili damu!
Ella ikka benayyhu yisrael shemmetu echav mechamat mila, velo maluhu. leman deamar "veatta et beriti tishmor" — ikka, leman deamar "himmol yimmol" — lekka.
Uleman deamar "himmol yimmol" lekka? vehatnan: "kunnam sheani nehene mimmulim" — asur bearle yisrael umuttar bemule ummot haolam, alma af al gav dela mehili keman dimhili damu!
Ella, ikka benayyhu ishsha, leman deamar "veatta et beriti tishmor" — lekka, deishsha lav bat mila hi, uleman deamar "himmol yimmol" — ikka, deishsha keman dimhila damya.

Umi ikka leman deamar ishsha la? vehachtiv: "vattikkach tzippora tzor"! keri beh "vattakkach". vehachtiv "vattichrot"! keri beh "vattachret", deamra leinish acharina vaavad. veibbaet ema: (atya) [atayy] ihi veatchila, vaata moshe veagmera.
Mishna mitrappein mehen rippuy mamon, aval lo rippuy nefashot. veen mistapperin mehen bechol makom, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: birshut harabbim muttar, aval lo beno leveno.
Gemara may "rippuy mamon", umay "rippuy nefashot"? illema "rippuy mamon" besachar, "rippuy nefashot" bechinnam — litne: mitrappein mehen besachar aval lo bechinnam!
Ella, "rippuy mamon" — davar sheen bo sakkana, "rippuy nefashot" — davar sheyyesh bo sakkana. vehaamar rav yehuda: afillu rivda dechusilta la mittassenan minnayyhu!
Ella, "rippuy mamon" — behemto, "rippuy nefashot" — gufeh, vehayeynu deamar rav yehuda: afillu rivda dechusilta la mittassenan minnayyhu.
Amar rav chisda amar mar ukeva: aval im amar lo sam peloni yafe lo, sam peloni ra lo — muttar.
b: Savar shayyole meshael lo, ki hechi demashil lo meshael leinish acharina, vaata hahu gavra leoroe nafsheh.
Amar rava amar rabbi yochanan, veamri la amar rav chisda amar rabbi yochanan: safek chay safek met — en mitrappein mehen, vadday met — mitrappein mehen.
Met? haikka chayye shaa! lechayye shaa la chayyshinan.
Umena temra dilchayye shaa la chayyshinan? dichtiv: "im amarnu navo hair veharaav bair vamatnu sham", vehaikka chayye shaa! ella lav lechayye shaa la chayyshinan.
Metivi: lo yissa veyitten adam im hamminin, veen mitrappein mehen afillu lechayye shaa.

Maase beven dama ben achoto shel rabbi yishmael shehikkisho nachash, uva yaakov ish kefar sechanya lerappooto, velo hinnicho rabbi yishmael, veamar lo: rabbi yishmael achi! hannach lo veerafe mimmennu, vaani avi mikra min hattora shehu muttar, velo hispik ligmor et haddavar ad sheyyatzta nishmato vamet.
Kara alav rabbi yishmael: ashrecha ben dama, sheggufecha tahor veyatzta nishmatcha betohora, velo avarta al divre chaverecha, shehayu omrim: "uforetz gader yishshechennu nachash".
Shane minut demashcha, deate lemimmeshach batrayyhu.
Amar mar: lo avarta al divre chaverecha, shehayu omrim: "uforetz gader yishshechennu nachash". ihu name chivya tarkeh! chivya derabbanan delet leh asuta kelal.
Umay hava leh lememar? "vechay bahem" — velo sheyyamut bahem.

Verabbi yishmael? hane mille betzina, aval befarhesya — la. detanya: haya rabbi yishmael omer: minnayin sheim omrim lo laadam "avod avoda zara veal tehareg", sheyyaavod veal yehareg? talmud lomar: "vechay bahem" — velo sheyyamut bahem. yachol afillu befarhesya? talmud lomar: "velo techallelu et shem kodshi".
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: kol makka shemmechallelin aleha et hashshabbat en mitrappein mehen, veikka deamri amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: kol

a: Makka shel chalal — en mitrappein mehen. may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu gav hayyad vegav haregel, deamar rav adda bar matna amar rav: gav hayyad vegav haregel hare hen kemakka shel chalal, umechallelin alehen et hashshabbat.

Amar rav zutera bar toviyya amar rav: kol makka shetztzericha omed, mechallelin aleha et hashshabbat. amar rav shemen bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: vehay ishshata tzemirta kemakka shel chalal dame, umechallelin aleha et hashshabbat.

Mehechan makka shel chalal? peresh rabbi amme: min hassafa velifnim. bae rabbi eliezer: kakke veshinne may? kevan daakushe ninhu kemakka devarae damu, o dilma, kevan degavvae kayymi, kemakka shel chalal damu?
Amar abbaye, ta shema: hachoshesh beshinnav lo yegammea bahen et hachometz. choshesh hu dela, ha kaev leh tuva — shappir dame. dilma tanna hecha dechaev leh tuva "choshesh" name kare leh.

Ta shema: rabbi yochanan chash betzafdina, azal legabba dehahi matronita, avada chamsha umaale shabbeta. amar la: lemachar may? amara leh: la tzerichat. i tzerichna may? amara: ishteva li dela megallet. ishteva la: "lelaha yisrael la megallena". galliyay leh, limchar nefak darsha befirka.
Veha ishteva la! "lelaha deyisrael la megallena", aval leammeh yisrael megallena. vehaikka chillul hashshem! degalli la meikkara.
Alma kemakka shel chalal damya. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: shane tzafdina, hoil umatchil befe vegomer bivne meayim.

May simaneh? rame midde be chakke, umayyte dema mibbe dare. mimmay have? mikkarire karire dechitte, umechammime chammime disare, umishshiyyure kasa deharsana. may avada leh? amar rabbi acha bereh derava: me seor veshemen zayit vamelach, umar bar rav ashe amar: mishcha daavavza begadpa daavavza.
Amar abbaye: ana avadi kullehu vela ittassay, ad daamar li hahu tayyaya: ayyti kashyayta dezeta dela melo tilta, ukelinhu ammara chadta, vedabbek (beh) [abbe] dedarech. avadi hachi veittassay.
Verabbi yochanan hechi aved hachi? vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: kol makka shemmechallelin aleha et hashshabbat — en mitrappein mehen! adam chashuv shane.
Veha rabbi avahu, deadam chashuv hava, urema leh yaakov minaa samma ashshakeh, vei la rabbi amme verabbi assi delachachu leshakeh, paskeh leshakeh!
Derabbi yochanan rofe mumeche hava, derabbi avahu name rofe mumeche hava, shane rabbi avahu demokmi beh mine benafshayyhu "tamot nafshi im pelishtim".
Amar shemuel: hay pedata sakkanta hi, umechallelin aleha et hashshabbat. may asuta? lemifsak dema — tachle bechalla, leassoke — girda deyavla vegirda daasanna, o nikra mikkilkalta.

Amar rav safra: hay inbeta parvavnka demalacha demota hi. may asuta? tigna beduvesha, o karpesa betilyay. addehachi vehachi, layte inbeta bat mina veniggandar (ilove) [illavay], chivvarti lechivvarti veukkamti leukkamti.
Amar rava: hay simta parvavnka deishshata hi, may asute? limchayeh shittin itkutele, velikreeh sheti vaerev, vehane mille dela chivvar resheh, aval chivvar resheh let lan ba.
Rabbi yaakov chash
b: Befika, ori leh rabbi amme, veamri la rabbi assi ori leh: layte shav bine ahala tolana, vetzayayr leh bachalala deve tzavvera, velichrich illaveh nira barka, vetamesh leh benitfa chivvara, velikleye uvadar leh illaveh. addehachi vehachi, layte kashyata daasanna, laynnach pika lahade pika.
Vehane mille pika illaa, pika tattaa may? layyte tarba ditzfirta dela ippetach, velifashshar velishde beh.

Vei la, layyte telat tarfe kara dimyaybshi betulla, velikle velivaddar illaveh. vei la, layyte meshakkede chelzone. vei la, mayyte meshach kira, velinkot beshachke dechittana bekayyta, vedaamar gufena besitvav.

Rabbi avahu chash beudeneh, ori leh rabbi yochanan, veamri lay be midresha. may ori leh? ki ha deamar abbaye: amara li em — la ibberay kuleyyta ella leudena. veamar rava: amar li minyome asya — kullehu (shakyaynu) [shakyayne] kashu leudena, levar mimmayya dechuleyyta. layyte kuleyyta devarcha karcha, velikreay sheti vaerev, velaynnach ammillela denura, vehanhu mayya denafki minneh lishdinhu beudeneh — la karire vela chammime, ella pashore.

Vei la, layyte tarba dechippusheta gamlanita, velifashshar velishde beh. vei la, lemalleyeh leudeneh mishcha, velebed shav petilata deaspasta, velayte shufeta detuma, veloytevv barka bechad resha, velitle behu nura, veiddach resha motevo beudena, veloytevv udeneh lehada nura, veyizdehar mizzika, venishkol chada venannach chada.
Lishshana acharina: vei la, layyte shav petilata bikra, veshayef leh mishcha deaspasta, venayyte chad resha benura vechad resha beudeneh, venishkol chada venannach chada, veyizdehar mizzika.

Vei la, layyte udera denada dela meshakkef venannach ba, velitleyyay leudeneh lahade nura, umizdehar mizzika. vei la, layyte guveta dekanya attika bar mea shenin, velimlecheh milcha gelalnita, velikle velidabbek. vesimanach: rattiva leyabbishta veyabbishta lerattiva.
Amar rabba bar zutera amar rabbi chanina: maalin oznayim beshabbat. tane rav shemuel bar yehuda: bayyad aval lo besam. ikka deamri: besam aval lo bayyad. may tama? mizrayf zaref.

Amar rav zutera bar toviyya amar rav: ayin shemmarda muttar lechochlah beshabbat. sevur minneh: hane mille hu dishchiki sammanin meetmol, aval mishchak beshabbat veetoye derech reshut harabbim — la. amar leh hahu merabbanan verabbi yaakov shemeh: ledidi mipparsha minneh derav yehuda, afillu mishchak beshabbat veetoye derech reshut harabbim — muttar.

Rav yehuda shera lemichchal ena beshabbat. amar lehu rav shemuel bar yehuda: man tzayet lihuda machel shabbe? lesof chash beeneh, shelach leh: shere o asir? shelach leh: lechulle alma shere, ledidach asir.

Vechi middidi hu? demar shemuel hi! hahi amta dahavay be mar shemuel, dikdacha la ena beshabbeta, tzevavcha, velekka deashgach ba. pekaa ena. limchar nefak mar shemuel uderash: ayin shemmarda — muttar lechochlah beshabbat. may tama? deshureyayne deena beovanta delibba telu.
Kegon may? amar rav yehuda: kegon rira, ditza, dema, dimata, vekidcha, utechillat uchela, leappoke sof uchela ufatztzoche ena — dela.

Amar rav yehuda: zibbura, udecharzeh silva, vesimta, udechaev leh ena, veate illaveh ishshata — kullehu be vane sakkanta. chamma lechamma, vesilka letzinna, vechillufa sakkanta. chammime leakrabba vekarire lezibbura, vechillufa sakkanta. chammime lesilva vekarire
